docs.title: In Another World
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

Here I am, in China, half way around the world from home.

我在这里，在距离家乡半个地球之外的中国。

half way around the world：相隔半个地球；离得非常远

002

As I look at my clock and calculate the time back home I realize that half a world away, people are busy getting ready for a wedding.

当我看着时钟计算回家的时间时，我意识到在半个地球之外，人们正在忙着准备婚礼。

calculate /ˈkælkjəˌleɪt/ 计算 realize /ˈriəˌlaɪz/ 意识到 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼

003

The bride is my niece, a person I first met when she was three days old.

新娘是我的侄女，我第一次见到她时她才三天。

bride /braɪd/ 新娘 niece /nis/ 侄女

004

I think back to the first time I had the opportunity to become acquainted with my niece.

我回想起第一次有机会认识我的侄女。

think back to：回想起 become acquainted with：开始认识；熟悉 opportunity /ˌɑpərˈtunəti/ 机会 niece /nis/ 侄女

005

As my sister cradled her in her arms, the infant girl clasped her mother's outstretched finger.

当我姐姐将她抱在怀里时，女婴紧握着母亲伸出的手指。

cradled /ˈkreɪdəl/ v. 轻轻抱着；把……放在摇篮里 clasped /klæspt/ 紧握着 outstretched /aʊtˈstrɛʧt/ 伸展的

006

My intuition told me that her temperament would be a sunny disposition, a joy to people around her.

我的直觉告诉我，她的性格会是阳光的性格，给周围的人带来欢乐。

intuition /ˌɪntuˈɪʃən/ 直觉 temperament /ˈtɛmpərmənt/ 气质 disposition /ˌdɪspəˈzɪʃən/ 性格

007

As she grew, the cute little girl had an infectious laugh that started as a small grin, then became a giggle and grew louder and louder until it triggered a response from all the people around her and they joined in.

随着她的成长，这个可爱的小女孩的笑声很有感染力，一开始只是小笑，然后变成咯咯笑，声音越来越大，直到引起周围所有人的反应，他们也加入进来。

infectious /ˌɪnˈfɛkʃəs/ 传染性的 started /ˈstɑrtɪd/ 开始了 triggered /ˈtrɪgərd/ 触发的 response /rɪˈspɑns/ 回复

008

As an adolescent, she studied hard and enjoyed well-deserved success in secondary school as she interacted with her peer group.

青少年时期，她努力学习，在中学时与同龄人交往，取得了当之无愧的成功。

adolescent /ˌædəˈlɛsənt/ 青少年 studied /ˈstədid/ v. 学习；研究 enjoyed /ˌɛnˈʤɔɪd/ 很享受 well-deserved /dɪˈzərvd/ 当之无愧 success /səkˈsɛs/ 成功

009

After receiving her high school diploma, she chose nursing as her career.

获得高中文凭后，她选择了护理作为她的职业。

receiving /rɪˈsivɪŋ/ v. 收到；获得 diploma /dɪˈploʊmɑ/ 文凭 nursing /ˈnərsɪŋ/ 护理

010

From the beginning of the young couples romance it was evident that they were compatible and were completely intrigued with each other.

从这对年轻情侣的浪漫开始，就可以看出他们很合得来，并且彼此完全感兴趣。

beginning /bɪˈgɪnɪŋ/ 开始 couples /ˈkəpəlz/ 情侣 romance /ˈroʊmæns/ 浪漫 evident /ˈɛvədənt/ 明显 compatible /kəmˈpætəbəl/ 兼容的

011

The couple had an engagement party when I was at home in Canada a few months ago.

几个月前，当我在加拿大的家里时，这对夫妇举办了订婚派对。

engagement /ɛnˈgeɪʤmənt/ 订婚

012

The party was in the form of a picnic in a beautiful rose garden.

聚会的形式是在美丽的玫瑰园野餐。

in the form of：以……形式 beautiful /ˈbjutəfəl/ 美丽的

013

To celebrate and to toast their future, we drank champagne.

为了庆祝并为他们的未来干杯，我们喝了香槟。

celebrate /ˈsɛləˌbreɪt/ 庆祝 champagne /ʃæmˈpeɪn/ 香槟酒

014

As they posed under an arch covered with climbing roses,we snapped pictures for their photo album.

当他们在覆盖着攀缘玫瑰的拱门下摆姿势时，我们为他们的相册拍了照片。

covered /ˈkəvərd/ 覆盖 climbing /ˈklaɪmɪŋ/ 攀登 snapped /snæpt/ 断然地 pictures /ˈpɪkʧərz/ 图片

015

The couple decided on a fall wedding.

这对夫妇决定在秋季举行婚礼。

decided /ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd/ 决定 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼

016

Plans for the wedding day were activated immediately.

婚礼当天的计划立即启动。

wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 activated /ˈæktɪˌveɪtɪd/ 活性 immediately /ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli/ 立即地

017

The decisions about the forthcoming event were shared by the whole family.

关于即将举行的活动的决定由全家人共同决定。

decisions /dɪˈsɪʒənz/ 决定 forthcoming /ˈfɔrθˈkəmɪŋ/ 即将推出

018

A close friend of the family was contacted and invited to sing a solo just prior to the ceremony.

在仪式前联系了该家庭的一位密友并邀请他独唱。

prior to：在……之前 contacted /ˈkɑnˌtæktɪd/ 接触过 invited /ˌɪnˈvaɪtɪd/ 邀请 ceremony /ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni/ 仪式

019

The day before the ceremony, a rehearsal would take place so that the remainder of the details could be looked after and attended to.

仪式前一天，将进行一次排练，以便照顾和处理其余的细节。

take place：发生；举行 ceremony /ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni/ 仪式 rehearsal /rɪˈhərsəl/ 排演 remainder /rɪˈmeɪndər/ 余 details /ˈditeɪlz/ 细节 attended /əˈtɛndəd/ 出席

020

The planning that takes place beforehand for one of these events and all the work that the big day entails, with many people collaborating to make the event run smoothly, are immense.

为其中一项活动提前进行的计划以及这一重要日子所需的所有工作，以及许多人的合作以使活动顺利进行，都是巨大的。

planning /ˈplænɪŋ/ 规划 beforehand /bɪˈfɔˌrhænd/ 预先 entails /ɪnˈteɪlz/ 需要 collaborating /kəˈlæbərˌeɪtɪŋ/ 合作 smoothly /sˈmuðli/ 顺利

021

The conscientious attention to detail will be evident to the spectators of this event.

对于本次活动的观众来说，对细节的认真关注是显而易见的。

conscientious /ˌkɑnʃiˈɛnʃəs/ 尽责的 attention /əˈtɛnʃən/ 注意力 evident /ˈɛvədənt/ 明显 spectators /ˈspɛkteɪtərz/ 观众

022

I can imagine the excitement and emotions of the family today.

我可以想象今天一家人的兴奋和激动。

imagine /ˌɪˈmæʤən/ 想象 excitement /ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/ 激动 emotions /ˈɪˌmoʊʃənz/ 情绪

023

The time is near.

时间快到了。

024

The ceremony will begin in 3 short hours.

仪式将在短短 3 个小时后开始。

ceremony /ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni/ 仪式

025

The bride will be radiant as she comes down the aisle escorted by her father.

当新娘在父亲的护送下走上红毯时，她会容光焕发。

bride /braɪd/ 新娘 radiant /ˈreɪˌdiənt/ 容光焕发的 aisle /aɪəl/ 走道 escorted /ɛˈskɔrtɪd/ 护送

026

She will wear her grandmother's pearls as an accessory.

她将佩戴祖母的珍珠作为配饰。

grandmother /ˈgrændˌməðər/ 祖母 accessory /ækˈsɛsəri/ 配饰

027

Her veil will be the same one as her cousin wore last year.

她的面纱将与她表弟去年戴的面纱相同。

veil /veɪl/ 面纱

028

As is customary, under her garments she will wear a blue garter.

按照惯例，她的衣服下面会系一条蓝色吊袜带。

customary /ˈkəstəˌmɛri/ 习惯的 garments /ˈgɑrmənts/ 服装 garter /ˈgɑrtər/ 袜带

029

As part of the tradition of Canadian weddings, she will be wearing something old (the pearls), something new (her gown), something borrowed (the veil) and something blue (the garter).

作为加拿大婚礼传统的一部分，她会穿一些旧的（珍珠）、一些新的（她的礼服）、一些借来的（面纱）和一些蓝色的（吊袜带）。

tradition /trəˈdɪʃən/ 传统 weddings /ˈwɛdɪŋz/ 婚礼 wearing /ˈwɛrɪŋ/ 穿着 something /ˈsəmθɪŋ/ 某物 gown /gaʊn/ 袍

030

As the first chords of the wedding march are played (a melody familiar to all), the congregation will rise.

当婚礼进行曲的第一和弦响起时（所有人都熟悉的旋律），会众将起立。

wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 familiar /fəˈmɪljər/ 熟悉的 congregation /ˌkɑŋgrəˈgeɪʃən/ 会众

031

Gasps will be heard as they catch a glimpse of the bride in her gorgeous wedding gown.

当他们看到穿着华丽婚纱的新娘时，会听到喘息声。

catch a glimpse of：瞥见 bride /braɪd/ 新娘 gorgeous /ˈgɔrʤəs/ 华丽的 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 gown /gaʊn/ 袍

032

The mother of the bride will calmly view this whole event, though tears will blur her vision.

新娘的母亲会平静地看待这整个事件，尽管泪水会模糊她的视线。

bride /braɪd/ 新娘 blur /blər/ 模糊

033

She will be overcome with sentiment at her daughter's apparent happiness.

她会因女儿表面上的幸福而感伤不已。

be overcome with：被某种情绪压倒 sentiment /ˈsɛnəmənt/ 情绪 daughter /ˈdɔtər/ 女儿 apparent /əˈpɛrənt/ 明显的 happiness /ˈhæpinəs/ 幸福

034

The picture will be one that will embody hope for the future of humanity.

这张照片将体现人类未来的希望。

picture /ˈpɪkʧər/ 图片 humanity /juˈmænɪti/ 人类

035

As the couple exchange wedding vows they will be affirming their love and making a commitment to each other.

当这对夫妇交换结婚誓言时，他们将确认他们的爱并对彼此做出承诺。

exchange /ɪksˈʧeɪnʤ/ 交换 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 vows /vaʊz/ 誓言 affirming /əˈfərmɪŋ/ 肯定 commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/ 承诺

036

All the spectators are there to wish them well.

所有观众都在那里祝愿他们一切顺利。

wish them well：祝他们一切顺利 spectators /ˈspɛkteɪtərz/ 观众

037

As the time approaches, I think back to other family weddings over many years.

随着时间的临近，我回想起多年来的其他家庭婚礼。

think back to：回想起 approaches /əˈproʊʧɪz/ 方法 weddings /ˈwɛdɪŋz/ 婚礼

038

My older sisters were all married in the same church and as brides they carried a white Bible decorated with tiny roses.

我的姐姐们都在同一座教堂结婚，作为新娘，她们带着一本装饰着小玫瑰的白色圣经。

sisters /ˈsɪstərz/ 姐妹 married /ˈmɛrid/ 已婚 carried /ˈkɛrid/ 携带 decorated /ˈdɛkərˌeɪtɪd/ 装饰的

039

The receptions for their weddings were all held in the same church basement, as there was no large banquet hall in the local area.

由于当地没有大型宴会厅，他们的婚礼招待会都在同一个教堂地下室举行。

receptions /rɪˈsɛpʃənz/ 招待会 weddings /ˈwɛdɪŋz/ 婚礼 basement /ˈbeɪsmənt/ 地下室 banquet /ˈbæŋkwət/ 宴会

040

The feast was usually catered by a group of church members.

宴会通常由一群教会成员主持。

feast /fist/ 盛宴 usually /ˈjuʒəwəli/ 通常 catered /ˈkeɪtərd/ 迎合 members /ˈmɛmbərz/ 会员

041

Today's wedding reception will be held in an arena that will be decorated with just the right amount of fall flowers in wonderful arrays to give it dignity yet a touch of glamour.

今天的婚宴将在一个场地举行，场地将用适量的秋花装饰，排列精美，既高贵又迷人。

wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 reception /rɪˈsɛpʃən/ 接待 decorated /ˈdɛkərˌeɪtɪd/ 装饰的 flowers /flaʊərz/ 花朵 wonderful /ˈwəndərfəl/ 精彩的

042

The table decorations will be a masterpiece.

餐桌装饰将是一件杰作。

decorations /ˌdɛkərˈeɪʃənz/ 装饰 masterpiece /ˈmæstərˌpis/ 杰作

043

One of the table decorations will be small pumpkins, used as containers for flowers that were collected from family gardens, surrounded by a large wreath made from long stalks of wheat.

餐桌装饰之一是小南瓜，用作从家庭花园收集的鲜花的容器，周围环绕着由长麦秆制成的大花环。

decorations /ˌdɛkərˈeɪʃənz/ 装饰 pumpkins /ˈpəmpkənz/ 南瓜 containers /kənˈteɪnərz/ 容器 flowers /flaʊərz/ 花朵 collected /kəˈlɛktəd/ 集

044

There will be a few coloured leaves placed inside the wreath.

花环内会放置一些彩色叶子。

coloured /ˈkələrd/ 有色

045

Maybe they will use oak and maple leaves to show the splendour of the autumn colours.

也许他们会用橡树和枫叶来展现秋天的绚丽色彩。

oak /oʊk/ 橡木 maple /ˈmeɪpəl/ 枫 splendour：辉煌 colours /ˈkələr/ 颜色

046

The colour of the outfits that the bridesmaids are wearing will be fall colours as well.

伴娘所穿服装的颜色也将是秋季颜色。

outfits /ˈaʊtˌfɪts/ 服装 bridesmaids /ˈbraɪdzˌmeɪdz/ 伴娘 wearing /ˈwɛrɪŋ/ 穿着 colours /ˈkələr/ 颜色

047

The ingenious decorations will be appreciated by the many guests attending the festivities.

巧妙的装饰将受到众多参加庆祝活动的客人的赞赏。

ingenious /ˌɪnˈʤinjəs/ 巧妙 decorations /ˌdɛkərˈeɪʃənz/ 装饰 appreciated /əˈpriʃiˌeɪtɪd/ 赞赏 attending /əˈtɛndɪŋ/ 出席 festivities /fɛˈstɪvətiz/ 庆祝活动

048

At each place setting there will be a special paper napkin with the bride and groom's name printed on it and the date of their wedding.

每个场所都会有一张特殊的餐巾纸，上面印有新娘和新郎的名字以及婚礼日期。

setting /ˈsɛtɪŋ/ 环境 special /ˈspɛʃəl/ 特别的 bride /braɪd/ 新娘 printed /ˈprɪnɪd/ 打印 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼

049

It will be carefully folded placed on top and of a linen napkin.

将其小心折叠并放在亚麻餐巾的顶部。

carefully /ˈkɛrfəli/ 小心

050

This will be one of the souvenirs the guests will have to commemorate the special wedding day.

这将是宾客纪念特别婚礼的纪念品之一。

souvenirs /ˌsuvəˈnɪrz/ 纪念品 commemorate /kəˈmɛmərˌeɪt/ 纪念 special /ˈspɛʃəl/ 特别的 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼

051

Also at each place will be a few after dinner mints for the guests.

每个地方还会为客人提供一些餐后薄荷糖。

052

A miniature tree will also be placed at each person's place.

每个人的位置还将放置一棵微型树。

miniature /ˈmɪnɪˌʧʊr/ 微型

053

The intent is for the guests to take the little tree home and transplant it to a special place.

目的是让客人把小树带回家，移植到一个特别的地方。

transplant /trænˈsplænt/ 移植 special /ˈspɛʃəl/ 特别的

054

In this way, our environment is also improved and the tree will become a living tribute to the young couple.

这样，我们的环境也得到了改善，这棵树也将成为这对年轻夫妇的活祭。

environment /ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/ 环境 improved /ˌɪmˈpruvd/ 改进的 tribute /ˈtrɪbjut/ 贡

055

The groom will carry her across the threshold as is customary for a young couple as they begin their new life together.

新郎将抱着她跨过门槛，这是年轻夫妇一起开始新生活的惯例。

threshold /θˈrɛˌʃoʊld/ 临界点 customary /ˈkəstəˌmɛri/ 习惯的 together /təˈgɛðər/ 一起

056

The honeymoon plans will take them to the west coast of Canada.

蜜月计划将带他们去加拿大西海岸。

honeymoon /ˈhəniˌmun/ 蜜月 coast /koʊst/ 海岸

057

They will have a week of privacy far away from friends and family.

他们将有一周远离朋友和家人的隐私。

privacy /ˈpraɪvəsi/ 隐私 friends /frɛndz/ 朋友们

058

They will inhabit a condominium in the town of Whistler, British Columbia, in the Rocky Mountains.

他们将居住在不列颠哥伦比亚省落基山脉惠斯勒镇的一套公寓里。

inhabit /ˌɪnˈhæbət/ 栖息 condominium /ˌkɑndəˈmɪniəm/ 公寓 columbia /kəˈləmbiə/ 哥伦比亚 mountains /ˈmaʊntənz/ 山

059

They will feel as if they are royalty living in a mansion in this little bit of paradise on earth.

他们会感觉自己就像是住在这座人间天堂的豪宅里的皇室成员。

royalty /ˈrɔɪəlti/ 版税 mansion /ˈmænʃən/ 大厦 paradise /ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs/ 天堂

060

Thereafter, they will return home to Ontario where they will reside.

此后，他们将返回他们将居住的安大略省。

thereafter /ðɛˈræftər/ 此后

061

Their original plan to spend their honeymoon on board a yacht in the Mediterranean Sea was abandoned when world circumstances dictated that our country Canada was a safer choice.

当世界形势表明我们国家加拿大是一个更安全的选择时，他们原本计划在地中海的游艇上度蜜月，但他们放弃了。

original /ərˈɪʤənəl/ 原来的 honeymoon /ˈhəniˌmun/ 蜜月 yacht /jɑt/ 游艇 abandoned /əˈbændənd/ 弃 circumstances /ˈsərkəmˌstænsɪz/ 情况

062

Earlier this month, as I thought about the forthcoming marriage, and knew that I would be unable to attend, I decided to write a message to the young couple.

本月早些时候，当我想到即将举行的婚礼并知道自己无法参加时，我决定给这对年轻夫妇写一封信。

earlier /ˈərliər/ 早些时候 thought /θɔt/ 想法 forthcoming /ˈfɔrθˈkəmɪŋ/ 即将推出 marriage /ˈmɛrɪʤ/ 婚姻 decided /ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd/ 决定

063

The intent was that the message would be read aloud during the wedding reception.

目的是在婚宴上大声朗读这条信息。

message /ˈmɛsɪʤ/ 信息 wedding /ˈwɛdɪŋ/ 婚礼 reception /rɪˈsɛpʃən/ 接待

064

In the message, I wished them well and urged them to cherish each other every day.

在留言中，我祝福他们一切顺利，并嘱咐他们要珍惜彼此每一天。

message /ˈmɛsɪʤ/ 信息 cherish /ˈʧɛrɪʃ/ 珍惜

docs.title: Unit 02 万圣节：让我们盛装打扮起来
Let's Dress Up——It's Halloween
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

From early childhood getting dressed up is connected with a special pastime in North America, called Halloween.

从孩提时代起，盛装打扮就与北美的一种特殊消遣联系在一起，即万圣节。

childhood /ˈʧaɪlˌdhʊd/ 童年 dressed /drɛst/ 穿着 connected /kəˈnɛktɪd/ 已连接 special /ˈspɛʃəl/ 特别的 pastime /ˈpæˌstaɪm/ 消遣

002

Halloween is celebrated on the last night of October, when the air is crisp and snow is not far off.

万圣节是在十月的最后一个晚上庆祝的，那时空气清新，雪已经不远了。

celebrated /ˈsɛləˌbreɪtɪd/ 著名

003

Every young child is acquainted with this exciting tradition.

每个年幼的孩子都熟悉这个令人兴奋的传统。

acquainted /əkˈweɪnɪd/ 认识的 exciting /ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ/ 令人兴奋的 tradition /trəˈdɪʃən/ 传统

004

On the last day of October when dinner is finished, children hurry to dress up in a costume.

十月的最后一天，晚餐结束后，孩子们赶紧穿上盛装。

dress up：盛装打扮；装扮 finished /ˈfɪnɪʃt/ 完成的 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 costume /ˈkɑstum/ 戏服

005

Darkness comes early at this time of year and caution must be practiced, foremost by the children who are going from house to house, “trick or treat”.

每年的这个时候，黑暗来得早，必须小心谨慎，尤其是那些挨家挨户“不给糖就捣蛋”的孩子们。

trick or treat：不给糖就捣蛋 darkness /ˈdɑrknəs/ 黑暗 caution /ˈkɔʃən/ 警告 practiced /ˈpræktɪst/ 练习过的 foremost /ˈfɔrˌmoʊst/ 最重要的 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们

006

Parents warn their children not to dart out in front of cars.

家长警告孩子不要在汽车前冲出。

parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们

007

In all the excitement it is easy for children to become distracted and ignore safety rules.

在所有的兴奋中，孩子们很容易分心并忽视安全规则。

excitement /ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/ 激动 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 distracted /dɪˈstræktɪd/ 愣

008

Planning what your costume will be, ahead of time, is part of the fun of the evening.

提前计划你的服装是当晚的乐趣之一。

ahead of time：提前 planning /ˈplænɪŋ/ 规划 costume /ˈkɑstum/ 戏服 evening /ˈivnɪŋ/ 晚上

009

Many mothers will spend time fabricating outfits for their little girls who suddenly turn into circus clowns, beautiful ballet dancers or weird colorful bugs.

许多妈妈会花时间为她们的小女儿制作服装，让她们突然变成马戏团小丑、美丽的芭蕾舞演员或奇怪的彩色虫子。

turn into：变成 mothers /ˈməðərz/ 母亲们 fabricating /ˈfæbrɪˌkeɪtɪŋ/ 制造 outfits /ˈaʊtˌfɪts/ 服装 suddenly /ˈsədənli/ 突然 beautiful /ˈbjutəfəl/ 美丽的

010

Fathers may help their sons construct a costume of foil armor.

父亲们可以帮助他们的儿子制作一套箔盔甲服装。

fathers /ˈfɑðərz/ 父亲们 construct /ˈkɑnstrəkt/ 构造 costume /ˈkɑstum/ 戏服 foil /fɔɪl/ 挫败

011

Little boys often enjoy pretending they are in the army so on Halloween it is possible to see squads of lieutenants and sergeants marching along in the dark.

小男孩经常喜欢假装自己在军队，因此在万圣节那天，可能会看到一队队的中尉和中士在黑暗中行进。

pretending /priˈtɛndɪŋ/ 假装 army /ˈɑrmi/ 军队 possible /ˈpɑsəbəl/ 可能的 lieutenants /luˈtɛnənts/ 中尉 sergeants /ˈsɑrʤənts/ 军士

012

We affiliate this celebration with the supernatural so some children may choose to wear a skeleton costume bearing a skull and crossbones, or even a monster costume.

我们将这种庆祝活动与超自然现象联系在一起，因此一些孩子可能会选择穿着带有骷髅和交叉骨的骷髅服装，甚至是怪物服装。

affiliate /əˈfɪliˌeɪt/ 附属机构 celebration /ˌsɛləˈbreɪʃən/ 庆典 supernatural /ˌsupərˈnæʧərəl/ 超自然 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 skeleton /ˈskɛlətən/ 骨骼

013

The choice of wardrobe for the evening is really limitless.

晚上的衣柜选择确实是无限的。

wardrobe /ˈwɔrˌdroʊb/ 衣柜 evening /ˈivnɪŋ/ 晚上 limitless /ˈlɪmətləs/ 无限

014

Witches can be seen riding on broomsticks across well illuminated intersections.

可以看到女巫骑着扫帚穿过照明良好的十字路口。

witches /ˈwɪʧɪz/ 女巫 broomsticks /ˈbrumˌstɪks/ 扫帚 illuminated /ˌɪˈluməˌneɪtəd/ 照亮的 intersections /ˌɪntərˈsɛkʃənz/ 交叉点

015

Earlier in the evening they may have concocted a witch's brew to quench their thirst for their arrival home.

傍晚早些时候，他们可能调制了女巫的啤酒来解渴回家。

earlier /ˈərliər/ 早些时候 evening /ˈivnɪŋ/ 晚上 concocted /kənˈkɑktəd/ 炮制的 witch /wɪʧ/ 巫婆 brew /bru/ 酿造

016

Ghosts can be heard groaning and moaning while they glide along city streets.

当幽灵沿着城市街道滑行时，可以听到它们的呻吟声和呻吟声。

groaning /ˈgroʊnɪŋ/ 呻吟 moaning /ˈmoʊnɪŋ/ 呻吟 glide /glaɪd/ 滑行 streets /strits/ 街道

017

Beautiful butterflies flutter by on their way to a party.

美丽的蝴蝶在前往聚会的路上翩翩飞过。

beautiful /ˈbjutəfəl/ 美丽的 butterflies /ˈbətərˌflaɪz/ 蝴蝶 flutter /ˈflətər/ 扑

018

Pirates carrying swords and pistols roam about, patches over one eye.

携带剑和手枪的海盗四处游荡，一只眼睛上戴着眼罩。

pirates /ˈpaɪrəts/ 海盗 carrying /ˈkɛriɪŋ/ 携带 pistols /ˈpɪstəlz/ 手枪 roam /roʊm/ 漫游 patches /ˈpæʧɪz/ 补丁

019

Small aliens search for a new home here on Earth.

小外星人在地球上寻找新家。

020

Wearing a cape and mask allows a child to become Superman for a few hours and enter the world of fantasy.

穿上斗篷和面具，孩子可以在几个小时内变成超人，进入奇幻世界。

wearing /ˈwɛrɪŋ/ 穿着 cape /keɪp/ 岬 mask /mæsk/ 面具 superman /ˈsupərˌmæn/ 超人 fantasy /ˈfænəsi/ 幻想

021

An ethnic flavor is introduced as a band of gypsies dance along under a bright full moon.

当一群吉普赛人在明亮的满月下跳舞时，一种民族风味被引入。

ethnic /ˈɛθnɪk/ 种族的 introduced /ˌɪntrəˈdust/ 介绍 gypsies /ˈʤɪpsiz/ 吉普赛人 moon /mun/ 月亮

022

Of course you can always see a certain number of Native American costumes, the buckskin jackets and dresses decorated with fringe and beads.

当然，你总能看到一定数量的美洲原住民服饰，比如饰有流苏和珠子的鹿皮夹克和连衣裙。

certain /ˈsərtən/ 肯定 costumes /ˈkɑstumz/ 服装 buckskin /ˈbəkˌskɪn/ 鹿皮 jackets /ˈʤækɪts/ 夹克 dresses /ˈdrɛsɪz/ 连衣裙

023

Some youngsters choose to decorate only their faces with grease paint instead of wearing masks.

一些年轻人选择只用油彩装饰自己的脸，而不是戴口罩。

youngsters /ˈjəŋstərz/ 年轻人 decorate /ˈdɛkərˌeɪt/ 装饰 instead /ˌɪnˈstɛd/ 反而 wearing /ˈwɛrɪŋ/ 穿着

024

In many ways this is safer for a child, making visibility clearer.

从很多方面来说，这对孩子来说更安全，视野更清晰。

visibility /ˌvɪzəˈbɪlɪti/ 能见度 clearer /ˈklɪrər/ 更清晰

025

At the same time a mask allows them to remain anonymous to all but their closest friends.

与此同时，面具可以让他们对除了最亲密的朋友之外的所有人保持匿名。

mask /mæsk/ 面具 anonymous /əˈnɑnəməs/ 匿名的 closest /ˈkloʊsəst/ 最接近的 friends /frɛndz/ 朋友们

026

Usually, on the night before Halloween, family members gather together to carve a pumpkin.

通常，在万圣节前一天晚上，家人会聚在一起雕刻南瓜。

usually /ˈjuʒəwəli/ 通常 members /ˈmɛmbərz/ 会员 together /təˈgɛðər/ 一起 carve /kɑrv/ 雕刻 pumpkin /ˈpəmpkɪn/ 南瓜

027

On Halloween night the candle lit face of the pumpkin shines from each home welcoming the little ghosts and goblins to call.

万圣节之夜，蜡烛点亮的南瓜脸从每个家庭发出光芒，欢迎小鬼和妖精的召唤。

pumpkin /ˈpəmpkɪn/ 南瓜 welcoming /ˈwɛlkəmɪŋ/ 欢迎 goblins /ˈgɑblɪnz/ 妖精

028

Parents usually escort small children around their own neighborhood helping to keep them safe.

父母通常会护送小孩在自己的社区周围活动，以确保他们的安全。

parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 usually /ˈjuʒəwəli/ 通常 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 neighborhood /ˈneɪbərˌhʊd/ 邻里 helping /ˈhɛlpɪŋ/ 帮助

029

Small children only visit random houses, their parent's friends mostly, while older children knock at every door.

小孩子只会拜访随机的房子，大多是他们父母的朋友，而大孩子则敲每一扇门。

children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 friends /frɛndz/ 朋友们

030

Crowding onto the front porch of the house the children rap at the door and chant the refrain “trick or treat”.

孩子们挤在房子的前廊上，敲着门，高喊着“不给糖就捣蛋”的副歌。

trick or treat：不给糖就捣蛋 crowding /ˈkraʊdɪŋ/ 拥挤 porch /pɔrʧ/ 门廊 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 chant /ʧænt/ 呗 refrain /rɪˈfreɪn/ 避免

031

Householders distribute candies, apples, peanuts, or any edible treat into decorated wooden six quart baskets, or plastic bags.

住户将糖果、苹果、花生或任何可食用的食物放入装饰好的六夸脱木制篮子或塑料袋中。

householders /ˈhaʊsˌhoʊldərz/ 户主 distribute /dɪˈstrɪbjut/ 分发 candies /ˈkændiz/ 糖果 peanuts /ˈpiˌnəts/ 花生 decorated /ˈdɛkərˌeɪtɪd/ 装饰的

032

They may be asked to recite a poem or sing a song before receiving their treat.

他们可能会被要求在接受款待之前背诵一首诗或唱一首歌。

receiving /rɪˈsivɪŋ/ 接收

033

Some lucky children may receive cookies from a freshly baked batch of chocolate chip cookies.

一些幸运的孩子可能会收到一批新鲜出炉的巧克力饼干。

children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 receive /rɪˈsiv/ 收到 cookies /ˈkʊkiz/ 曲奇饼 freshly /ˈfrɛʃli/ 新鲜地 chocolate /ˈʧɔklət/ 巧克力

034

On arriving home the children will dump all the junk candy out onto the floor to examine their loot.

到家后，孩子们会将所有垃圾糖果倒在地板上检查他们的战利品。

arriving /ərˈaɪvɪŋ/ 到达 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 examine /ɪgˈzæmɪn/ 检查 loot /lut/ 抢劫

035

Usually there is a great racket as brothers and sisters compare what goodies they have collected.

当兄弟姐妹们比较他们收集到的好东西时，通常会引起很大的喧闹。

usually /ˈjuʒəwəli/ 通常 brothers /ˈbrəðərz/ 兄弟 sisters /ˈsɪstərz/ 姐妹 compare /kəmˈpɛr/ 比较 goodies /ˈgʊdiz/ 好东西

036

Adults, too, like to join in Halloween celebrations by attending small house parties or large group gatherings at halls or arenas.

成年人也喜欢通过参加小型家庭聚会或在大厅或竞技场举行的大型团体聚会来参加万圣节庆祝活动。

celebrations /ˌsɛləˈbreɪʃənz/ 庆祝活动 attending /əˈtɛndɪŋ/ 出席 parties /ˈpɑrtiz/ 聚会 gatherings /ˈgæðərɪŋz/ 聚会

037

They may play the old traditional games such as bobbing for apples, which float in tubs of water, telling ghost stories and visiting a haunted house.

他们可能会玩一些古老的传统游戏，比如捡苹果（苹果漂浮在水桶里）、讲鬼故事和参观鬼屋。

traditional /trəˈdɪʃənəl/ 传统的 bobbing /ˈbɑbɪŋ/ 摆动 telling /ˈtɛlɪŋ/ 讲述 ghost /goʊst/ 鬼 stories /ˈstɔriz/ 故事

038

Everyone seems to get enjoyment from being slightly afraid.

每个人似乎都从轻微的恐惧中获得乐趣。

everyone /ˈɛvriˌwən/ 每个人 enjoyment /ˌɛnˈʤɔɪmənt/ 享受 slightly /sˈlaɪtli/ 轻微地

039

If you live in the country the hooting of an owl or even the howl of a wolf underlines the spooky atmosphere of Halloween evening.

如果你住在乡下，猫头鹰的叫声甚至狼的嚎叫声都会凸显万圣节之夜的怪异气氛。

country /ˈkəntri/ 国家 hooting /hut/ 倒彩 owl /aʊl/ 猫头鹰 wolf /wʊlf/ 狼 underlines /ˈəndərˌlaɪnz/ 下划线

040

Clouds scuttle across the face of the moon and the flap of a bird's wings can be heard as it settles on the bare branches of a tree.

云朵掠过月亮的表面，当鸟落在光秃秃的树枝上时，可以听到鸟儿拍打翅膀的声音。

scuttle /ˈskətəl/ 天窗 moon /mun/ 月亮 settles /ˈsɛtəlz/ 解决 branches /ˈbrænʧɪz/ 分支机构

041

Eyes gleam in the night as a black cat crosses your path.

当一只黑猫穿过你的道路时，你的眼睛在夜色中闪闪发光。

crosses /ˈkrɔsɪz/ 十字架

042

Bats swoop about in the dark startling those who are nervous.

蝙蝠在黑暗中飞来飞去，吓坏了那些紧张的人。

startling /ˈstɑrtlɪŋ/ 令人震惊的 nervous /ˈnərvəs/ 紧张的

043

On this evening it is not necessary to be extravagant to have a good time.

在这个晚上，没有必要铺张浪费来享受美好时光。

evening /ˈivnɪŋ/ 晚上 necessary /ˈnɛsəˌsɛri/ 必要的 extravagant /ɛkˈstrævəgənt/ 靡

044

A little imagination and a sense of fun will create a memory of Halloween night for many years.

一点点想象力和一点乐趣就会创造出多年来万圣节之夜的记忆。

imagination /ˌɪˌmæʤəˈneɪʃən/ 想像力

docs.title: Gardening
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

One of the quiet joys of life in the southern part of Ontario, Canada, is gardening.

加拿大安大略省南部安静的生活乐趣之一就是园艺。

southern /ˈsəðərn/ 南部 gardening /ˈgɑrdənɪŋ/ 园艺

002

Whether pursued as a hobby or solely to improve the esthetic value of one's home, the pleasure derived is only exceeded by the therapeutic benefit.

无论是作为一种爱好还是仅仅为了提高家居的审美价值，所带来​​的乐趣都超过了治疗效果。

whether /ˈwɛðər/ 无论 pursued /pərˈsud/ 被追赶 improve /ˌɪmˈpruv/ 提升 esthetic /ɛsˈθɛtɪk/ 审美的 pleasure /ˈplɛʒər/ 乐趣

003

The exercise involved in working in a garden is helpful in keeping people in good physical condition.

在花园里工作所涉及的锻炼有助于保持人们良好的身体状况。

exercise /ˈɛksərˌsaɪz/ 锻炼 involved /ˌɪnˈvɑlvd/ 涉及 working /ˈwərkɪŋ/ 在职的 helpful /ˈhɛlpfəl/ 有帮助的 keeping /ˈkipɪŋ/ 保持

004

It has become a ritual for homeowners to spend late winter weekends browsing through seed catalogues while sitting on their couch.

Some people erect barricades to keep small animals from attacking the plants.

有些人竖起路障，防止小动物攻击植物。

barricades /ˈbɛrəˌkeɪdz/ 路障 animals /ˈænəməlz/ 动物 attacking /əˈtækɪŋ/ 攻击

065

Squirrels love to dig up flower bulbs.

松鼠喜欢挖球根花卉。

squirrels /skwərəlz/ 松鼠

066

They find them a tasty treat.

他们发现它们是一种美味的享受。

067

It is common to see ceramic fixtures or figurines in a garden.

在花园里常见陶瓷装置或雕像。

ceramic /sərˈæmɪk/ 陶瓷制品 fixtures /ˈfɪksʧərz/ 固定装置 figurines /ˌfɪgjərˈinz/ 雕像

068

Even the untrained eye can tell that the imitations are a fake, yet properly placed, they add to the intrinsic beauty.

即使未经训练的眼睛也能看出仿制品是假货，但如果放置得当，它们会增添内在的美感。

untrained /ənˈtreɪnd/ 未经训练的 imitations /ˌɪmɪˈteɪʃənz/ 仿制品 properly /ˈprɑpərli/ 适当地 intrinsic /ˌɪnˈtrɪnsɪk/ 固有的

069

A rain gauge, attached by a bracket to a fence, is a common sight and is used to enable the gardener to diagnose the moisture level of the soil around the plants and determine if they need more water.

通过支架固定在栅栏上的雨量计很常见，园丁可以用它来诊断植物周围土壤的湿度并确定它们是否需要更多的水。

attached /əˈtæʧt/ 随附的 bracket /ˈbrækɪt/ 括号 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁 diagnose /ˌdaɪəgˈnoʊs/ 诊断 moisture /ˈmɔɪsʧər/ 水分

070

If nature does not provide enough rain, then the gardener will use a plastic or rubber hose to provide more irrigation.

如果大自然没有提供足够的雨水，那么园丁将使用塑料或橡胶软管来提供更多的灌溉。

provide /prəˈvaɪd/ 提供 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁 plastic /ˈplæstɪk/ 塑料 hose /hoʊz/ 软管 irrigation /ˌɪrəˈgeɪʃən/ 灌溉

071

With a twist of a knob, or by moving a lever, the thirst of the plants for moisture can be quenched.

通过旋转旋钮或移动杠杆，植物对水分的渴求就可以得到缓解。

knob /nɑb/ 旋钮 moisture /ˈmɔɪsʧər/ 水分 quenched /kwɛnʧ/ 淬火

072

What greater pleasure, than to work in your garden and as you clip the overgrown plants back to size or prune branches of fruit trees, hear the buzz of bees, You know that they are enjoying your garden as they extract the pollen from the blooms.

还有什么比在你的花园里工作更令人愉快的事呢？当你把杂草丛生的植物修剪成适当的大小或修剪果树的树枝时，听到蜜蜂的嗡嗡声，你知道它们正在享受你的花园，因为它们从花朵中提取花粉。

greater /ˈgreɪtər/ 更大 pleasure /ˈplɛʒər/ 乐趣 overgrown /ˌoʊvərˈgroʊn/ 杂草丛生 branches /ˈbrænʧɪz/ 分支机构 buzz /bəz/ 嗡嗡声

073

You relish the feeling that you are one with nature.

您享受与自然融为一体的感觉。

feeling /ˈfilɪŋ/ 感觉

074

The hum of insects as they share the garden is more pleasurable than music from a stereo or a symphony to a devoted gardener.

对于忠诚的园丁来说，昆虫分享花园时的嗡嗡声比立体声音乐或交响乐更令人愉悦。

hum /həm/ 哼 insects /ˈɪnˌsɛkts/ 昆虫 pleasurable /ˈplɛʒərəbəl/ 愉快的 symphony /ˈsɪmfəni/ 交响乐 devoted /dɪˈvoʊtɪd/ 奉献的

075

In addition, the scent of the flowers is an integral part of the joy of spending time working in a garden.

此外，花香是在花园里工作的乐趣的一个组成部分。

addition /əˈdɪʃən/ 添加 scent /sɛnt/ 香味 flowers /flaʊərz/ 花朵 integral /ˈɪnəgrəl/ 不可缺少的 spending /ˈspɛndɪŋ/ 开支

076

The irony of the situation is that nature sometimes conspires against the gardener, and a hailstorm can riddle beautiful plants, shredding their leaves in minutes.

具有讽刺意味的是，大自然有时会与园丁作对，一场冰雹可以让美丽的植物陷入困境，在几分钟内撕碎它们的叶子。

situation /ˌsɪʧuˈeɪʃən/ 情况 sometimes /ˈsəmˌtaɪmz/ 有时 conspires /kənˈspaɪər/ 密谋 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁 hailstorm /ˈheɪlˌstɔrm/ 冰雹

077

Hurricanes can uproot even the largest trees although this is an event that seldom occurs in Southern Ontario.

飓风甚至可以将最大的树木连根拔起，尽管这种情况在安大略省南部很少发生。

hurricanes /ˈhərəˌkeɪnz/ 飓风 largest /ˈlɑrʤəst/ 最大的 although /ˌɔlˈðoʊ/ 虽然 southern /ˈsəðərn/ 南部

078

Tornadoes are more likely in this area.

该地区更有可能发生龙卷风。

tornadoes /tɔrˈneɪdoʊz/ 龙卷风

079

Parasites can attack plants and threaten their survival.

寄生虫会攻击植物并威胁其生存。

parasites /ˈpɛrəˌsaɪts/ 寄生虫 threaten /θˈrɛtən/ 威胁 survival /sərˈvaɪvəl/ 生存

080

Any number of things can become a plague.

许多事情都可能成为瘟疫。

plague /pleɪg/ 瘟疫

081

It is often difficult to discern exactly what it is that is destroying the precious plants.

通常很难准确地辨别是什么正在破坏这些珍贵的植物。

difficult /ˈdɪfəkəlt/ 难的 discern /dɪˈsərn/ 辨别 exactly /ɪgˈzæktli/ 确切地 destroying /dɪˈstrɔɪɪŋ/ 破坏 precious /ˈprɛʃəs/ 宝贵的

082

Any number of complications can shatter the gardener's dream of surpassing last year's accomplishment.

任何数量的并发症都可能粉碎园丁超越去年成就的梦想。

complications /ˌkɑmpləˈkeɪʃənz/ 并发症 shatter /ˈʃætər/ 粉碎 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁 surpassing /sərˈpæsɪŋ/ 超越 accomplishment /əˈkɑmplɪʃmənt/ 成就

083

An authentic gardener will not brood about the disappointment for long.

一个真正的园丁不会长期沉浸在失望之中。

authentic /əˈθɛnɪk/ 真正的 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁 disappointment /ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntmənt/ 失望

084

Even as the disaster is occurring, you might overhear the gardener murmur “There's always next year.”

即使灾难正在发生，你也可能会无意中听到园丁低声说：“明年总会有的。”

disaster /dɪˈzæstər/ 灾难 occurring /əˈkərɪŋ/ 发生 overhear /ˈoʊvərˈhir/ 无意中听到 gardener /ˈgɑrdənər/ 园丁

docs.title: Unit 04 一个加拿大家庭的故事
A Canadian Family Story
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

My story begins in Newfoundland where my brother and I were born during the Second World War.

我的故事始于纽芬兰，我和我的兄弟在第二次世界大战期间出生在那里。

brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 war /wɔr/ 战争

002

The island of Newfoundland, which was originally a British colony, became the newest province of Canada in 1949, the same year that the People's Republic of China was born.

纽芬兰岛原本是英国殖民地，于 1949 年成为加拿大最新的省份，同年中华人民共和国诞生。

originally /ərˈɪʤənəli/ 起初 province /ˈprɑvɪns/ 省 republic /riˈpəblɪk/ 共和国

003

Our mother was born and raised in Newfoundland.

我们的母亲在纽芬兰出生和长大。

004

During the War (World War II), she worked in St. John's, the capital city, where she met a young Canadian sailor from Ontario.

战争期间（第二次世界大战），她在首都圣约翰斯工作，在那里她遇到了一位来自安大略省的年轻加拿大水手。

war /wɔr/ 战争 capital /ˈkæpɪtəl/ 首都

005

He was a member of the crew of a Royal Canadian Navy ship that was part of one of the convoys that escorted supply ships across the Atlantic Ocean to Europe during the war.

他是加拿大皇家海军一艘舰艇的船员，该舰艇是战争期间护送补给船穿越大西洋前往欧洲的护航舰队的一部分。

ship /ʃɪp/ 船 convoys /ˈkɑnˌvɔɪz/ 车队 escorted /ɛˈskɔrtɪd/ 护送 atlantic /əˈtlæntɪk/ 大西洋 war /wɔr/ 战争

006

They fell in love and subsequently, got married.

他们坠入爱河，随后结婚了。

subsequently /ˈsəbsəkwəntli/ 随后 married /ˈmɛrid/ 已婚

007

The rest is history, so to speak.

可以这么说，其余的都是历史了。

history /ˈhɪstəri/ 历史

008

Our family moved to Ontario in late 1945, just after the war ended.

1945 年末，战争刚刚结束，我们全家搬到了安大略省。

war /wɔr/ 战争

009

In 1999, acting on impulse, my brother and I decided to take our mother to Newfoundland for a visit.

1999年，一时冲动，我和哥哥决定带母亲去纽芬兰探访。

impulse /ˌɪmˈpəls/ 冲动 brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 decided /ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd/ 决定

010

It had been almost fifty years since we had last visited our mother's outport (remote or very rural island village) where she grew up.

自从我们上次访问母亲长大的外港（偏远或非常乡村的岛屿村庄）以来，已经快五十年了。

visited /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/ 访问过 outport：外港 village /ˈvɪlɪʤ/ 村庄

011

It was also the 50th anniversary of Newfoundland's becoming part of Canada.

这也是纽芬兰并入加拿大 50 周年纪念日。

anniversary /ˌænəˈvərsəri/ 周年纪念日 becoming /bɪˈkəmɪŋ/ 成为

012

In 1950, I was six and my brother was five when we last visited our mother's childhood home.

1950 年，当我们最后一次拜访母亲儿时的家时，我六岁，我哥哥五岁。

brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 visited /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/ 访问过 childhood /ˈʧaɪlˌdhʊd/ 童年

013

At that time, Ireland's Eye was a vibrant, quaint fishing village hugging the rocky shore of a small, enclosed harbour.

当时，爱尔兰之眼是一个充满活力、古色古香的渔村，坐落在一个封闭的小港口的岩石海岸上。

ireland /ˈaɪərlənd/ 爱尔兰 vibrant /ˈvaɪbrənt/ 充满活力的 fishing /ˈfɪʃɪŋ/ 钓鱼 village /ˈvɪlɪʤ/ 村庄 hugging /ˈhəgɪŋ/ 拥抱

014

There was no electricity.

没有电。

electricity /ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti/ 电

015

There were no roads, no automobiles, and few signs of automation of any type.

没有道路，没有汽车，也几乎没有任何类型的自动化迹象。

automobiles /ˌɔtəmoʊˈbilz/ 汽车 automation /ɔtəˈmeɪʃən/ 自动化

016

There were oil lamps and wood stoves in the homes and mere sootpaths between the aggregate of small communities on the hilly island, also named Ireland's Eye.

家里有油灯和柴火炉，这座丘陵岛屿上的小社区之间只有烟灰路，也被称为“爱尔兰之眼”。

sootpaths：烟炱路径 aggregate /ˈægrəgət/ 总计的 communities /kəmˈjunɪtiz/ 社区 ireland /ˈaɪərlənd/ 爱尔兰

017

We can still see and hear the inboard motorboats, putt putting (sound of engines) into the harbour, hauling their day's catch of fish.

我们仍然可以看到和听到舷内的摩托艇，驶入港口（引擎的声音），拖着当天捕获的鱼。

inboard /ˈɪnˌbɔrd/ 舷内 motorboats /ˈmoʊtərˌboʊt/ 摩托艇 putting /ˈpʊtɪŋ/ 推杆 engines /ˈɛnʤənz/ 发动机 harbour /ˈhɑrbər/ 港口

018

The image of hardy fishermen with pitchforks hoisting and tossing the codfish up to the stilted platforms from the bowels of the boats is still quite vivid.

勇敢的渔民用干草叉将鳕鱼从船舱内吊上吊台的画面仍然历历在目。

fishermen /ˈfɪʃərmɪn/ 渔民 pitchforks /ˈpɪʧˌfɔrks/ 干草叉 hoisting /ˈhɔɪstɪŋ/ 吊装 tossing /ˈtɔsɪŋ/ 折腾 codfish：鳕鱼

019

The aroma of salted, drying codfish, lingers still.

咸干鳕鱼的香味依然萦绕不去。

codfish：鳕鱼 lingers /ˈlɪŋgərz/ 徘徊

020

What I remember best, of almost half a century ago, was going out with my Uncle Fred in his boat to fish.

大约半个世纪前，我记得最清楚的是和我的弗雷德叔叔一起乘船去钓鱼。

remember /rɪˈmɛmbər/ 记住 century /ˈsɛnʧəri/ 世纪

021

That particular day, we were huddled together and lashed to other boats, just outside of the harbour.

那天，我们挤在一起，绑在港口外的其他船上。

particular /ˌpɑˈtɪkjələr/ 特别的 huddled /ˈhədəld/ 挤成一团 together /təˈgɛðər/ 一起 outside /ˈaʊtˈsaɪd/ 外部 harbour /ˈhɑrbər/ 港口

022

I can still hear the lively gossip between my uncle and the other fishermen, above the rippling and splashing of the waves against the hulls of the boats.

我仍然可以听到叔叔和其他渔民之间热闹的闲聊声，海浪拍打着船体的涟漪和溅水声。

fishermen /ˈfɪʃərmɪn/ 渔民 rippling /ˈrɪpəlɪŋ/ 荡漾 splashing /ˈsplæʃɪŋ/ 溅起

023

I remember the boats heaving periodically, on the huge gently rolling waves.

我记得小船在巨大的、轻轻滚动的波浪上周期性地起伏。

remember /rɪˈmɛmbər/ 记住 heaving /ˈhivɪŋ/ 起伏 periodically /ˌpiriˈɑdɪkəli/ 定期地 rolling /ˈroʊlɪŋ/ 滚动

024

My Uncle Fred had only one arm, but amazingly, he could do everything as if he had two hands.

我的叔叔弗雷德只有一只手臂，但令人惊讶的是，他可以做任何事情，就像他有两只手一样。

amazingly /əˈmeɪzɪŋli/ 令人惊奇地 everything /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/ 一切

025

He could even roll a cigarette and light it.

他甚至可以卷起一根香烟并点燃它。

cigarette /ˌsɪgəˈrɛt/ 卷烟

026

These are my memories of the quaint Newfoundland glory days gone by.

这些是我对纽芬兰过去的古色古香的辉煌岁月的回忆。

memories /ˈmɛməriz/ 回忆

027

It was a very hard life in those out ports, but a life romantically cherished by most of those who lived it.

那些外港的生活非常艰苦，但大多数人都非常珍惜这种生活。

romantically /roʊˈmæntɪkəli/ 浪漫地 cherished /ˈʧɛrɪʃt/ 珍惜的

028

Our mother was not feeling up to the trip at the time we were ready to leave, but insisted that my brother and I go on this odyssey.

当我们准备离开时，我们的母亲对这次旅行感到不舒服，但坚持让我和我的兄弟继续这次冒险。

feeling /ˈfilɪŋ/ 感觉 insisted /ˌɪnˈsɪstɪd/ 坚持 brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 odyssey /ˈɑdəsi/ 奥德赛

029

We would later provide her with pictures, a written account, and videotape of the trip.

我们稍后会向她提供这次旅行的照片、书面记录和录像带。

provide /prəˈvaɪd/ 提供 pictures /ˈpɪkʧərz/ 图片 written /ˈrɪtən/ 书面 account /əˈkaʊnt/ 帐户 videotape /ˈvɪdioʊˈteɪp/ 录像带

030

Although we toured other parts of Newfoundland, including an overnight stay on the French Islands of St. Pierre and Miquilon, just off the south coast of Newfoundland, our main objective was to visit Ireland's Eye.

虽然我们游览了纽芬兰的其他地方，包括在纽芬兰南海岸附近的法属圣皮埃尔岛和米奎隆岛过夜，但我们的主要目标是参观爱尔兰之眼。

although /ˌɔlˈðoʊ/ 虽然 including /ˌɪnˈkludɪŋ/ 包括 overnight /ˈoʊvərˈnaɪt/ 过夜 islands /ˈaɪləndz/ 岛屿 miquilon：米奎隆

031

This necessitated finding water transportation.

这就需要寻找水路运输。

necessitated /nəˈsɛsəˌteɪtəd/ 必要的 finding /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/ 发现 transportation /ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən/ 运输

032

We managed to arrange for a boat to take us on the half hour trip to the island.

我们设法安排了一艘船带我们进行半小时的岛上之旅。

managed /ˈmænɪʤd/ 管理的 arrange /əreɪnʤ/ 安排

033

As it turned out, the married couple who ferried us over to the island was actually a couple of our distant cousins, whom we had never met.

原来，送我们去岛上的那对夫妇实际上是我们素未谋面的远房表兄弟夫妇。

as it turned out：结果是；后来证明 married /ˈmɛrid/ 已婚 ferried /ˈfɛrid/ 渡轮 actually /ˈæˌkʧuəli/ 实际上 distant /ˈdɪstənt/ 遥远 cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹

034

We had intended to have our cousins drop us off on the island and pick us up a few hours later.

我们本来打算让表兄弟把我们送到岛上，几个小时后来接我们。

intended /ˌɪnˈtɛndɪd/ 故意的 cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹

035

However, either because we were newly found cousins, or they were typically hospitable Newfoundlanders, or they thought that my brother and I would get lost, they wanted to stay with us.

然而，要么因为我们是新近发现的表兄弟，要么因为他们是典型的好客的纽芬兰人，或者他们认为我和我的兄弟会迷路，他们想和我们住在一起。

however /ˌhaʊˈɛvər/ 然而 because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为 cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹 typically /ˈtɪpɪkəli/ 通常 hospitable /ˈhɑˈspɪtəbəl/ 好客

036

Probably all three factors influenced their decision.

可能这三个因素都影响了他们的决定。

probably /ˈprɑbəˌbli/ 大概 factors /ˈfæktərz/ 因素 influenced /ˈɪnfluənst/ 影响 decision /dɪˈsɪʒən/ 决定

037

They were absolutely fabulous.

他们绝对棒极了。

absolutely /ˌæbsəˈlutli/ 绝对地 fabulous /ˈfæbjələs/ 神话般的

038

They got caught up in what my brother and I were trying to do.

他们陷入了我和我兄弟想做的事情中。

brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟

039

They were very knowledgeable about the island and the people who had once lived there.

他们对这个岛和曾经住在那里的人们非常了解。

knowledgeable /ˈnɑləʤəbəl/ 知识渊博的

040

Clutching a narrative of the island, written by another of our cousins, the forgotten history of that special place became more coherent to the four of us.

手里拿着我们另一个表兄弟写的关于这个岛的故事，这个特殊地方被遗忘的历史对我们四个人来说变得更加连贯。

clutching /ˈkləʧɪŋ/ 紧抓 narrative /ˈnɛrətɪv/ 叙述 written /ˈrɪtən/ 书面 cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹 forgotten /fərˈgɑtən/ 忘记了

041

As we entered Ireland's Eye's small harbour, which was guarded, by a family of hawks in a nest high on a rocky point, a weird sensation came over us.

当我们进入爱尔兰之眼的小港口时，一种奇怪的感觉笼罩着我们。

entered /ˈɛnərd/ 进入 ireland /ˈaɪərlənd/ 爱尔兰 harbour /ˈhɑrbər/ 港口 guarded /ˈgɑrdɪd/ 被守护的 sensation /sɛnˈseɪʃən/ 感觉

042

There, in front of us, was the place we visited fifty years before, and about which we had heard and read so much throughout our adult lives.

就在我们面前，是我们五十年前访问过的地方，我们在成年生活中听到和读到过很多关于它的地方。

visited /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/ 访问过

043

We thought, what an aesthetically breathtaking sight!

我们想，这是多么令人叹为观止的景象啊！

thought /θɔt/ 想法 aesthetically /ɛsˈθɛtɪkli/ 审美地 breathtaking /ˈbrɛθˌteɪkɪŋ/ 惊险

044

The glittering sun, on that day, gave everything a picturepostcard image.

那一天，灿烂的阳光给一切都赋予了明信片般的画面。

glittering /ˈglɪtərɪŋ/ 闪闪发光的 everything /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/ 一切 picture /ˈpɪkʧər/ 图片 postcard /ˈpoʊˌskɑrd/ 明信片

045

This was indeed a slice of paradise.

这确实是一片天堂。

paradise /ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs/ 天堂

046

The ruins of a few remaining buildings that dotted the hillsides and shoreline and the once dominant St. Georges Church on the hill at the end of the harbour, aroused in us an exciting sense of history and of our heritage.

山坡和海岸线上点缀着一些残存建筑物的废墟，以及港口尽头山上曾经占主导地位的圣乔治教堂，唤起了我们对历史和遗产的激动人心的感觉。

remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ 其余的 buildings /ˈbɪldɪŋz/ 建筑物 hillsides /ˈhɪlˌsaɪdz/ 山坡 shoreline /ˈʃɔˌrlaɪn/ 海岸线 dominant /ˈdɑmənənt/ 主导的

047

Looking out over the harbour from the hill by the church at the extinct community, revived memories of fifty years before.

从教堂旁的山上眺望海港，看到这个已经灭绝的社区，又唤起了五十年前的记忆。

harbour /ˈhɑrbər/ 港口 extinct /ɪkˈstɪŋkt/ 灭绝的 community /kəmˈjunɪti/ 社区 revived /rɪˈvaɪvd/ 复活了 memories /ˈmɛməriz/ 回忆

048

With a greater clarity of the knowledge of the area, we walked from the church a little farther inland to what used to be the post office and the school that our mother attended, the skeletal shells of which were still standing precariously.

随着对该地区的了解更加清楚，我们从教堂步行到内陆稍远一点的地方，来到了曾经的邮局和我们母亲就读的学校，它们的骨架仍然摇摇欲坠地矗立着。

greater /ˈgreɪtər/ 更大 clarity /ˈklɛrɪti/ 明晰 knowledge /ˈnɑlɪʤ/ 知识 farther /ˈfɑrðər/ 更远 attended /əˈtɛndəd/ 出席

049

From there, stopping periodically to eat some edible berries, we struggled behind our cousins through the heavily brush and shrub covered footpaths to Black Duck Cove to visit the cemetery where our grandmother, whom we never knew, was buried.

从那里，我们时不时地停下来吃一些可食用的浆果，然后艰难地跟在我们表兄弟的后面，穿过茂密的灌木丛和灌木覆盖的小路，到达黑鸭湾，参观埋葬着我们素不相识的祖母的墓地。

stopping /ˈstɑpɪŋ/ 停止 periodically /ˌpiriˈɑdɪkəli/ 定期地 berries /ˈbɛriz/ 浆果 struggled /ˈstrəgəld/ 挣扎着 cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹

050

This sacred ground was in very bad condition, with many badly corroded gravestones buried under brush and long grass.

这片圣地的状况非常糟糕，许多严重腐蚀的墓碑埋在灌木丛和长草下。

condition /kənˈdɪʃən/ 状况 corroded /kərˈoʊdɪd/ 腐蚀的 gravestones /ˈgreɪvˌstoʊnz/ 墓碑

051

After searching for a few minutes in the midst of tangled vegetation, we found our grandmother's resting place beside which we paid our respects.

在杂乱的植被中寻找了几分钟后，我们找到了祖母的休息处，并在旁边表达了敬意。

searching /ˈsərʧɪŋ/ 寻找 minutes /ˈmɪnəts/ 分钟 tangled /ˈtæŋgəld/ 纠结的 vegetation /ˌvɛʤəˈteɪʃən/ 植被 grandmother /ˈgrændˌməðər/ 祖母

052

It was a good thing that our cousins stayed with us, as the footpaths that traversed the island, were overgrown with brush.

幸好我们的表兄弟和我们住在一起，因为穿过岛上的小路长满了灌木丛。

cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹 footpaths /ˈfʊtˌpæθ/ 人行道 traversed /ˈtrævərst/ 穿越过 overgrown /ˌoʊvərˈgroʊn/ 杂草丛生

053

It would have been virtually impossible for my brother and me, to walk to the other communities on the island.

对于我和我的兄弟来说，步行到岛上的其他社区几乎是不可能的。

virtually /ˈvərʧuəli/ 几乎 impossible /ˌɪmˈpɑsəbəl/ 不可能的 brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 communities /kəmˈjunɪtiz/ 社区

054

We made our way back to the church on the hill and descended to the boat for a half hour boat ride to the other side of the island.

我们回到山上的教堂，然后下船，乘船半小时到达岛的另一边。

descended /dɪˈsɛndɪd/ 下降

055

Sailing through a number of islets, we arrived at what remains of the small village of Traytown, where our grandparents had lived.

航行穿过许多小岛，我们到达了特雷敦小村庄的遗迹，我们的祖父母曾居住在那里。

sailing /ˈseɪlɪŋ/ 航行 arrived /əraɪvd/ 到达的 remains /rɪˈmeɪnz/ 遗迹 village /ˈvɪlɪʤ/ 村庄 traytown：特雷敦

056

There, we met some more long lost relatives at a small cottage.

在那里，我们在一座小小屋里遇到了一些失散多年的亲戚。

relatives /ˈrɛlətɪvz/ 亲属 cottage /ˈkɑtɪʤ/ 小屋

057

One, a bit of an eccentric, who now lives in Toronto but takes summer refuge in Traytown, showed us the remnants of what had once been our grandparents'house.

其中一位有点古怪，现在住在多伦多，但在特雷敦避暑，他向我们展示了曾经是我们祖父母的房子的遗迹。

eccentric /ˌɛkˈsɛntrɪk/ 偏心 toronto /tərˈɑntoʊ/ 多伦多 traytown：特雷敦 remnants /ˈrɛmnənts/ 残余物 grandparents'house：祖父母的房子

058

Beside these ruins, was the still flourishing cluster of wild rose bushes, planted there many years ago by our step grandmother.

在这些废墟旁边，还有一簇仍然茂盛的野玫瑰丛，是我们的继祖母多年前种植的。

flourishing /ˈflərɪʃɪŋ/ 芊芊 cluster /ˈkləstər/ 簇 planted /ˈplænɪd/ 种植的 grandmother /ˈgrændˌməðər/ 祖母

059

A lot of people, many whom were more lost cousins, continually dropped in or gathered on the porch outside.

很多人，其中许多是失散的堂兄弟，不断地进来或聚集在外面的门廊上。

cousins /ˈkəzənz/ 表兄弟姐妹 continually /kənˈtɪnjuəli/ 不断地 dropped /drɑpt/ 掉落 gathered /ˈgæðərd/ 聚集 porch /pɔrʧ/ 门廊

060

After a cup of tea and some more chitchat (small talk) and some comic relief, we made our departure for the mainland.

喝了一杯茶，又闲聊了几句，又搞笑地放松了一下，我们就出发前往大陆了。

chitchat /ˈʧɪˌtʧæt/ 闲谈 departure /dɪˈpɑrʧər/ 离开 mainland /ˈmeɪnˌlænd/ 大陆

061

On the way, we passed other inlets with ghost communities on Ireland's Eye.

途中，我们经过了爱尔兰之眼上有幽灵社区的其他入口。

ghost /goʊst/ 鬼 communities /kəmˈjunɪtiz/ 社区 ireland /ˈaɪərlənd/ 爱尔兰

062

To add to the excitement of that special day, my brother spotted a humpback whale quite close, between the boat and the island.

为了让这个特殊的日子更加兴奋，我哥哥在船和岛屿之间很近的地方发现了一头座头鲸。

excitement /ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/ 激动 special /ˈspɛʃəl/ 特别的 brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 spotted /ˈspɑtɪd/ 斑 humpback /ˈhəmpˌbæk/ 座头鲸

063

Our visit to Ireland's Eye was a bittersweet experience for us.

对我们来说，参观爱尔兰之眼是一次苦乐参半的经历。

ireland /ˈaɪərlənd/ 爱尔兰 bittersweet /ˈbɪtərsˌwit/ 苦乐参半 experience /ɪkˈspɪriəns/ 经验

064

On the one hand, there was a sense of being at the very place where our relatives and ancestors had lived, worked and played.

一方面，有一种身处我们的亲戚和祖先曾经生活、工作和娱乐的地方的感觉。

relatives /ˈrɛlətɪvz/ 亲属 ancestors /ˈænˌsɛstərz/ 祖先

065

On the other hand, there was a sense of agonizing loss of what were once thriving communities on the island.

另一方面，人们对失去岛上曾经繁荣的社区感到痛苦。

agonizing /ˈægənaɪzɪŋ/ 痛苦的 thriving /θˈraɪvɪŋ/ 熙 communities /kəmˈjunɪtiz/ 社区

066

It was difficult to reconcile the past with the present, after a gap of fifty years of chronic degeneration of the communities.

在社区长期退化五十年之后，很难将过去与现在调和起来。

difficult /ˈdɪfəkəlt/ 难的 reconcile /ˈrɛkənˌsaɪl/ 调和 present /ˈprɛzənt/ 展示 chronic /ˈkrɑnɪk/ 慢性的 degeneration /dɪˌʤɛnərˈeɪʃən/ 退化

067

Today, the area is notorious for smuggling.

如今，该地区因走私而臭名昭著。

notorious /noʊˈtɔriəs/ 臭名昭著 smuggling /sˈməgəlɪŋ/ 走私

068

However, our mission was invaluable in that we were able to find out more about ourselves.

然而，我们的使命是无价的，因为我们能够更多地了解自己。

however /ˌhaʊˈɛvər/ 然而 mission /ˈmɪʃən/ 使命 invaluable /ˌɪnˈvæljəbəl/ 无价

069

The entire expedition to Newfoundland was a major highlight in each of our lives.

整个纽芬兰探险之旅是我们每个人生活中的一大亮点。

expedition /ˌɛkspəˈdɪʃən/ 远征 highlight /ˈhaɪˌlaɪt/ 强调

070

It tugged at our emotions at every turn.

它每时每刻都牵动着我们的情绪。

emotions /ˈɪˌmoʊʃənz/ 情绪

071

The people of Newfoundland, especially those of genetic connection, couldn't do enough for us.

纽芬兰人民，尤其是那些有血缘关系的人民，为我们竭尽全力。

especially /əˈspɛʃəli/ 尤其 genetic /ʤəˈnɛtɪk/ 遗传的 connection /kəˈnɛkʃən/ 联系 couldn't /ˈkʊdənt/ 不能

072

It was really like coming home, but then, that has always been the nature of Newfoundland courtesy, even to non-Newfoundlanders.

这真的就像回家一样，但是，这一直是纽芬兰礼貌的本质，即使对于非纽芬兰人也是如此。

courtesy /ˈkərtəsi/ 礼貌 non-newfoundlanders：非纽芬兰人

073

It was reassuring to see that the Newfoundland charm has transcended time.

令人欣慰的是，纽芬兰的魅力已经超越了时间。

reassuring /ˌriəˈʃʊrɪŋ/ 令人安心的 transcended /trænˈsɛndɪd/ 超越了

074

It has endured so many changes since Confederation in 1949.

自1949年联邦成立以来，它经历了许多变化。

endured /ɪnˈdʊrd/ 忍受 changes /ˈʧeɪnʤɪz/ 变化 confederation /kənˌfɛdərˈeɪʃən/ 联盟

075

My brother and I, eternally, will be Newfoundlanders and hope to go down home more often in the years to come.

我和我的兄弟将永远成为纽芬兰人，并希望在未来的几年里能更频繁地回家。

brother /ˈbrəðər/ 兄弟 eternally /ɪˈtərnəli/ 永远地 newfoundlanders：纽芬兰人

docs.title: The Fraud
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

Flushed with excitement, Kate stepped into the spatial vestibule and was immediately dazzled by the scene before her.

凯特满脸兴奋，踏入空间玄关，立刻就被眼前的景象惊呆了。

flushed /fləʃt/ adj. 激动得脸红的；泛红的 excitement /ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/ 激动 stepped /stɛpt/ v. 迈步；走进 spatial /ˈspeɪʃəl/ 空间的 vestibule /ˈvɛstɪˌbjul/ 前厅

002

The inlaid marble floor paved the way to a circular staircase rising three levels above her.

镶嵌的大理石地板铺平了通往她上方三层楼的圆形楼梯的道路。

circular /ˈsərkjələr/ adj. 圆形的；循环的 staircase /ˈstɛrˌkeɪs/ 楼梯

003

In a fountain in the center of the entryway stood a bronze dolphin balancing on its tail, its snout pointed to the lofty domed, stained glass skylight forty feet above.

入口中央的喷泉里站着一只青铜海豚，用尾巴保持平衡，它的鼻子指向四十英尺高的高耸的圆顶彩色玻璃天窗。

fountain /ˈfaʊntən/ 喷泉 entryway /ˈɛntriweɪ/ 入口通道 dolphin /ˈdɑlfən/ 海豚 balancing /ˈbælənsɪŋ/ 平衡 pointed /ˈpɔɪntɪd/ 尖

004

A massive chandelier, luminous in the bright sunlight, cast rainbow fairies dancing through the pink, green, and gold floral patterns of the floor and around the snowy white walls.

巨大的枝形吊灯在明亮的阳光下闪闪发亮，彩虹仙子在地板上的粉色、绿色和金色花卉图案中以及雪白的墙壁上翩翩起舞。

massive /ˈmæsɪv/ adj. 巨大的；大量的 chandelier /ʃændəˈlɪr/ 枝形吊灯 luminous /ˈlumənəs/ 发光的 sunlight /ˈsənˌlaɪt/ 阳光 rainbow /ˈreɪnˌboʊ/ 彩虹

005

Before she could fully appreciate the beauty of the intricate plaster work decorating the edges of the shallow niches installed in the walls to frame the numerous paintings, or, indeed, to appreciate the canvases themselves, her host, Victor Stone, approached.

还没等她完全欣赏到装饰在墙壁上的浅壁龛边缘的复杂石膏作品的美丽，这些壁龛安装在墙上，为无数的画作画框，或者说，实际上，还没来得及欣赏画布本身，她的主人维克多·斯通就走近了。

appreciate /əˈpriʃiˌeɪt/ 欣赏 intricate /ˈɪntrəkət/ 错综复杂 plaster /ˈplæstər/ 石膏 decorating /ˈdɛkərˌeɪtɪŋ/ 装饰 shallow /ˈʃæloʊ/ 浅的

006

Small by North American standards, he was perfectly proportioned.

按照北美标准，他身材娇小，但比例却非常完美。

standards /ˈstændərdz/ 标准 perfectly /ˈpərfəktli/ 完美 proportioned /prəˈpɔrʃənd/ 比例

007

Slightly balding at the forehead, his silver hair curved onto the collar of his pale blue shirt at the nape of his neck.

额头微微秃顶，银色的头发弯曲到颈背处的淡蓝色衬衫领子上。

slightly /sˈlaɪtli/ 轻微地 balding /ˈbɔldɪŋ/ 秃顶 forehead /ˈfɔrhɛd/ 前额

008

Laughing blue eyes startled her with their clarity.

蓝色的眼睛充满笑意，其清澈程度让她吃了一惊。

laughing /ˈlæfɪŋ/ 笑 startled /ˈstɑrtəld/ 受惊 clarity /ˈklɛrɪti/ 明晰

009

A straight, aristocratic nose rose to meet his slightly arched brows.

笔直的贵族鼻子与微弯的眉毛相交。

straight /streɪt/ 直的 aristocratic /ərˌɪstəˈkrætɪk/ 贵族式的 slightly /sˈlaɪtli/ 轻微地

010

His carefully manicured hands bore a single gold pinkie ring.

他精心修剪过的手上戴着一枚金色的小指戒指。

carefully /ˈkɛrfəli/ 小心 manicured /ˈmænɪkjərd/ 修剪整齐的

011

He held out his hand to take hers. “Thank you so much for coming, Kate.

他伸出手来握住她的手。 “非常感谢你的到来，凯特。

012

I am glad you could make it,” he said cheerfully.

我很高兴你能做到。”他高兴地说。

cheerfully /ˈʧɪrfəli/ 愉快地

013

She had never met this charming little man before and knew him by reputation only.

她以前从未见过这个迷人的小男人，只是听说而已。

charming /ˈʧɑrmɪŋ/ 迷人 reputation /ˌrɛpjəˈteɪʃən/ 名声

014

Among his contemporaries, he was known as a shrewd entrepreneur, able to diagnose at a glance, the prospects of those seeking his backing.

在他的同时代人中，他被称为精明的企业家，能够一眼就诊断出那些寻求他支持的人的前景。

contemporaries /kənˈtɛmpərˌɛriz/ 同时代人 entrepreneur /ˌɑntrəprəˈnʊr/ 企业家 diagnose /ˌdaɪəgˈnoʊs/ 诊断 prospects /ˈprɑspɛkts/ 前景 seeking /ˈsikɪŋ/ 寻求

015

She was anxious to learn why he had invited her to come to meet him at his home. “Thanks for asking me.

她很想知道他为什么邀请她去他家里见他。 “谢谢你问我。

anxious /ˈæŋʃəs/ 焦虑的 invited /ˌɪnˈvaɪtɪd/ 邀请

016

Nice place you have here.” She felt stupid saying something so absurd, but she was, at that moment, stumped.

你这里真是个好地方。”她觉得自己说出这么荒唐的话很愚蠢，但那一刻她却愣住了。

something /ˈsəmθɪŋ/ 某物 stumped /stəmpt/ 难住了

017

Her ego wouldn't let her admit she'd never in her whole life, been so impressed by a foyer.

她的自负不允许她承认她一生中从未对门厅印象如此深刻。

ego /ˈigoʊ/ 自我 wouldn't /ˈwʊdənt/ 不会 impressed /ˌɪmˈprɛst/ 印象深刻

018

She hoped that he would realize she'd had little experience with the elite, take pity on her, and show her around. “Would you like to see more of the house,” he asked, politely. “Would I, You bet!” She was happy he gave no indication that he thought she was not in his bracket.

她希望他能意识到她与精英交往的经验很少，怜悯她，带她四处看看。 “你想多看看房子吗？”他礼貌地问道。 “我愿意吗，你打赌！”她很高兴他没有表示他认为她不属于他的范围。

realize /ˈriəˌlaɪz/ 意识到 experience /ɪkˈspɪriəns/ 经验 politely /pəˈlaɪtli/ 礼貌地 indication /ˌɪndəˈkeɪʃən/ 指示 thought /θɔt/ 想法

019

She left her briefcase on the settee near the door and followed him through the foyer to a stairway to a stairway leading to a lower level of the house.

她把公文包放在靠近门的长椅上，跟着他穿过门厅，来到通往房子下层的楼梯。

briefcase /ˈbrifˌkeɪs/ 公文包 followed /ˈfɑloʊd/ 已关注 stairway /ˈstɛrˌweɪ/ 楼梯 leading /ˈlidɪŋ/ 领导

020

They began the tour in the wine cellar.

他们从酒窖开始了参观。

021

A heavy, double thick door opened to reveal row upon row of gleaming glass bottles of vintage wines, all lying on their sides, cradled by the solid oak racks.

一扇厚重的双厚门打开，露出一排排闪闪发光的玻璃瓶，里面装着年份葡萄酒，它们全部侧放在坚固的橡木架上。

gleaming /ˈglimɪŋ/ 闪闪发光的 bottles /ˈbɑtəlz/ 瓶子 vintage /ˈvɪntɪʤ/ 优质的 cradled /ˈkreɪdəl/ v. 轻轻抱着；把……放在摇篮里 oak /oʊk/ 橡木

022

The steady hum of machinery broke the silence of the insulated room.

机器持续的嗡嗡声打破了隔离室的寂静。

hum /həm/ 哼 machinery /məˈʃinəri/ 机械 silence /ˈsaɪləns/ 沉默 insulated /ˈɪnsəˌleɪtɪd/ 绝缘的

023

Victor explained that it was necessary to control the ventilation, temperature and humidity of the cellar to achieve optimum conditions for conserving the flavors of the expensive wines.

维克多解释说，有必要控制酒窖的通风、温度和湿度，以达到保存昂贵葡萄酒风味的最佳条件。

explained /ɪkˈspleɪnd/ 解释了 necessary /ˈnɛsəˌsɛri/ 必要的 control /kənˈtroʊl/ 控制 ventilation /ˌvɛntɪˈleɪʃən/ 通风 temperature /ˈtɛmpərəʧər/ 温度

024

The small but luxurious audio-visual theater was adjacent to the wine cellar.

小而豪华的视听剧场紧邻酒窖。

起初，我以为他在嘲笑我，但他向我发誓，他只是想确保这幅画能安全到达目的地，而且，因为它是古董货物的一部分，所以可以免除进口税。

thought /θɔt/ 想法 mocking /ˈmɑkɪŋ/ 嘲笑 painting /ˈpeɪnɪŋ/ 绘画 destination /ˌdɛstɪˈneɪʃən/ 目的地 because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为

093

It was a provocative offer, and even though I remained skeptical, I agreed.

这是一个挑衅性的提议，尽管我仍然持怀疑态度，但我还是同意了。

provocative /proʊˈvɑkətɪv/ 挑衅 remained /rɪˈmeɪnd/ 留下来 skeptical /ˈskɛptɪkəl/ 持怀疑态度的

094

A few days later, a crated painting arrived and was added to my goods ready for delivery to New York.

几天后，一幅装箱的画抵达并添加到我的货物中，准备运送到纽约。

painting /ˈpeɪnɪŋ/ 绘画 arrived /əraɪvd/ 到达的 delivery /dɪˈlɪvəri/ 送货

095

I had always subscribed to the theory that if something appeared to be too good to be true, it probably was.

我一直认同这样的理论：如果某件事看起来好得令人难以置信，那么它很可能就是真的。

subscribed /səbˈskraɪbd/ 已订阅 something /ˈsəmθɪŋ/ 某物 appeared /əˈpɪrd/ 出现了 probably /ˈprɑbəˌbli/ 大概

096

However, my greed prevailed and the painting was on its way.

然而，我的贪婪占了上风，这幅画仍在路上。

however /ˌhaʊˈɛvər/ 然而 prevailed /prɪˈveɪld/ 占了上风 painting /ˈpeɪnɪŋ/ 绘画

097

I was unaware at the time that my fortunes were about to go into a downward spiral.

当时我并没有意识到我的命运即将陷入螺旋式下降。

unaware /ˌənəˈwɛr/ 不知道 fortunes /ˈfɔrʧənz/ 财富 downward /ˈdaʊnwərd/ 向下

098

My benefactor, it turned out, was a man with a grudge against me.

原来，我的恩人是一个对我怀有怨恨的人。

benefactor /ˈbɛnəˌfæktər/ 恩人

099

Irrespective of the fact that I felt a deal we had made years before had been fair, he felt I had cheated him.

尽管我觉得我们几年前达成的协议是公平的，但他还是觉得我欺骗了他。

irrespective /ˌɪrəˈspɛktɪv/ 不顾一切 cheated /ˈʧitɪd/ 被骗了

100

I was about to be the recipient of his wrath.

我即将成为他愤怒的接受者。

recipient /rɪˈsɪpiənt/ 接受者

101

When my agent in New York went to customs to retrieve the shipment, he was greeted by a squad of police waiting to detain him on charges of smuggling cocaine.

当我在纽约的代理人去海关取回这批货物时，一队警察迎接了他，等待以走私可卡因的罪名拘留他。

customs /ˈkəstəmz/ 海关 retrieve /rɪˈtriv/ 取回 shipment /ˈʃɪpmənt/ 运输 greeted /ˈgritɪd/ 打招呼 squad /skwɑd/ 队

102

It appeared there was a bit of a discrepancy between what I was told was in the crate and the actual contents.

看来我被告知的板条箱中的内容与实际内容之间存在一些差异。

appeared /əˈpɪrd/ 出现了 discrepancy /dɪˈskrɛpənsi/ 差异 contents /ˈkɑntɛnts/ 内容

103

The drugs were in a hidden compartment in the crate.

这些毒品被放在板条箱的一个隐藏隔间里。

compartment /kəmˈpɑrtmənt/ 隔间

104

I admit it was naive of me to believe I had no enemies, but I didn't know anyone would go to this degree to prove how much he despised me.

我承认我相信自己没有敌人的想法很天真，但我不知道有人会达到这种程度来证明他有多么鄙视我。

believe /bɪˈliv/ 相信 enemies /ˈɛnəmiz/ 敌人 despised /dɪˈspaɪzd/ 被鄙视的

105

Hitherto, I had gone through life thinking that when two people agreed to a deal, if one of them got the better of the other, it was fair, because they did agree.

迄今为止，我一生都在想，当两个人同意达成一项协议时，如果其中一个人比另一个人更好，那是公平的，因为他们确实同意了。

hitherto /ˈhɪˌðərˈtu/ 迄今为止 thinking /ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/ 思维 because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为

106

Now I was learning that if you take advantage of some people, even with their permission, you aggravate them to seek revenge.

现在我了解到，如果你利用某些人，即使得到他们的许可，你也会激怒他们寻求报复。

learning /ˈlərnɪŋ/ 学习 advantage /ædˈvæntɪʤ/ 优势 permission /pərˈmɪʃən/ 允许 aggravate /ˈægrəˌveɪt/ 加剧 revenge /riˈvɛnʤ/ 复仇

107

I can't refute my recklessness.

我无法反驳我的鲁莽。

recklessness /ˈrɛkləsnəs/ 鲁莽

108

Almost seven years have elapsed since that time.

从那时起，已经过去了将近七年。

elapsed /ɪˈlæpst/ 过去

109

My agent took responsibility for the crime and went to jail for five years.

我的经纪人对这起罪行承担了责任并被判入狱五年。

responsibility /riˌspɑnsəˈbɪləti/ 责任

110

I felt guilty as hell, but I continued to pay him by sending the money to his family.

我感到非常内疚，但我还是继续付钱给他，把钱寄给他的家人。

continued /kənˈtɪnjud/ 持续 sending /ˈsɛndɪŋ/ 发送

111

I even withheld extra in a bonus account to give to him when he was released.

我什至在奖金账户里保留了额外的钱，等他被释放后送给他。

withheld /wɪθˈhɛld/ 扣留 account /əˈkaʊnt/ 帐户 released /riˈlist/ 释放

112

I also gave up my business and began to help others start their businesses.

我也放弃了自己的生意，开始帮助别人创业。

business /ˈbɪznɪs/ 商业 businesses /ˈbɪznɪsɪz/ 企业

113

In time, the guilt I felt subsided.

随着时间的推移，我的愧疚感消退了。

subsided /səbˈsaɪdɪd/ 消退了

114

I put my energies into stepping into the breach to help those less fortunate than I.

我把我的精力投入到突破口来帮助那些比我不幸的人。

energies /ˈɛnərʤiz/ 能量 stepping /ˈstɛpɪŋ/ 迈步 fortunate /ˈfɔrʧənət/ 幸运

115

To my amazement, my luck started to fluctuate upward and I flourished.

令我惊讶的是，我的运气开始好转，我的事业蒸蒸日上。

amazement /əˈmeɪzmənt/ 惊愕 started /ˈstɑrtɪd/ 开始了 fluctuate /ˈfləkʧəˌweɪt/ 波动 flourished /flərɪʃt/ 蓬勃发展

116

All you see here today, I have accumulated since that time.

你们今天在这里看到的一切，都是我从那时起积累的。

accumulated /əˈkjumjəˌleɪtɪd/ 积累

117

Now, it seems, my enemy has decided to reclaim his power over me.

现在看来，我的敌人决定夺回对我的权力。

decided /ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd/ 决定 reclaim /riˈkleɪm/ 回收

118

He has reported the crime and the erroneous imprisonment of my agent and named me as the person responsible for the offence.

他举报了我的代理人的罪行和错误监禁，并指定我为该罪行的责任人。

reported /ˌriˈpɔrtəd/ 报道 erroneous /ɛˈroʊniəs/ 错误 imprisonment /ˌɪmˈprɪzənmənt/ 监禁 responsible /riˈspɑnsəbəl/ 负责任的 offence：罪行

119

I had never changed my citizenship, so the F.

我从未改变过我的公民身份，所以 F.

changed /ʧeɪnʤd/ 改变了 citizenship /ˈsɪtɪzənˌʃɪp/ 国籍

120

B.

B.

121

I. wants me deported so they can prosecute me in New York.

我希望将我驱逐出境，以便他们可以在纽约起诉我。

deported /dɪˈpɔrtəd/ 被驱逐出境 prosecute /ˈprɑsəˌkjut/ 起诉

122

I hope I can induce you, through your column, to tell my story.

我希望我能通过你的专栏诱导你讲述我的故事。

123

Next week I have to appear before a magistrate for the preliminary hearing.

下周我必须出席地方法官的初步听证会。

magistrate /ˈmæʤɪˌstreɪt/ 地方法官 preliminary /prɪˈlɪməˌnɛri/ 初步的 hearing /ˈhirɪŋ/ 听力

124

If I'm not mistaken, public pressure might enable me to avoid deportation at least.

如果我没记错的话，公众压力至少可以让我避免被驱逐出境。

mistaken /mɪˈsteɪkən/ 错误 pressure /ˈprɛʃər/ 压力 deportation /ˌdipɔrˈteɪʃən/ 驱逐出境

125

I am more likely to get a fair trial here than there.

我在这里比在那里更有可能得到公平审判。

126

My record as a good citizen may offset the perception that I may be a criminal.

我作为一个好公民的记录可能会抵消我可能是一个罪犯的看法。

citizen /ˈsɪtɪzən/ 公民 perception /pərˈsɛpʃən/ 洞察力 criminal /ˈkrɪmənəl/ 刑事

127

What do you think, Will you help, Kate had listened to this synopsis in silence but her outrage was building.

你觉得怎么样，你能帮忙吗？凯特默默地听了这个概要，但她的愤怒正在积聚。

listened /ˈlɪsənd/ 听过 synopsis /sɪˈnɑpsɪs/ 概要 silence /ˈsaɪləns/ 沉默 outrage /ˈaʊˌtreɪʤ/ 暴行 building /ˈbɪldɪŋ/ 建筑

128

While his story seemed plausible, this plea for her assistance didn't quite fit.

虽然他的故事似乎有道理，但请求她的帮助却不太合适。

plausible /ˈplɔzəbəl/ 似是而非的 assistance /əˈsɪstəns/ 协助

129

With his financial resources, he could hire the best legal team in the country.

以他的财力，他可以聘请全国最好的法律团队。

financial /ˌfaɪˈnænʃəl/ 金融的 resources /ˈrisɔrsɪz/ 资源 country /ˈkəntri/ 国家

130

She realized she had to detach herself from her first impressions and extract fact from fiction.

她意识到她必须摆脱第一印象，从虚构中提取事实。

realized /ˈriəˌlaɪzd/ 实现了 impressions /ˌɪmˈprɛʃənz/ 印象数 extract /ˈɛkˌstrækt/ 提炼 fiction /ˈfɪkʃən/ 小说

131

Why didn't she believe him, Suddenly, it came to her.

她为什么不相信他，突然，她想到了。

believe /bɪˈliv/ 相信 suddenly /ˈsədənli/ 突然

132

Exposition of this version of Victor's tale would not only gain him public sympathy, it would invalidate any testimony against him.

维克多故事的这个版本的阐述不仅会为他赢得公众的同情，还会使任何针对他的证词失效。

exposition /ˌɛkspəˈzɪʃən/ 博览会 version /ˈvərʒən/ 版本 sympathy /ˈsɪmpəθi/ 同情 invalidate /ˌɪnˈvælɪˌdeɪt/ 无效 testimony /ˈtɛstɪˌmoʊni/ 见证

133

Nothing could constrain her when she realized she had literally been taken in by his story. “If you were innocent, why weren't you the defendant, If you were innocent all those years ago, why did your agent go to prison for you, Why did it take so long for your enemy to turn you in, The statute of limitations for that offence has expired.

当她意识到自己确实被他的故事所吸引时，没有什么可以限制她。 “如果你是无辜的，为什么你不是被告，如果你多年前是无辜的，为什么你的代理人会为你入狱，为什么你的敌人花了这么长时间才将你告发，该罪行的诉讼时效已经到期。

nothing /ˈnəθɪŋ/ 没有什么 constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ 约束 realized /ˈriəˌlaɪzd/ 实现了 literally /ˈlɪtərəli/ 字面上地 innocent /ˈɪnəsənt/ 清白的

134

I believe this has been a pathetic attempt to get me to mediate your case in the press.

我认为这是让我在媒体上调解你的案件的可悲尝试。

believe /bɪˈliv/ 相信 pathetic /pəˈθɛtɪk/ 可怜的 attempt /əˈtɛmpt/ 试图 mediate /ˈmidiˌeɪt/ 调解

135

I think you have always been an integral player in the criminal world and your past has caught up with you.

我认为你一直是犯罪世界中不可或缺的参与者，你的过去已经追上了你。

integral /ˈɪnəgrəl/ 不可缺少的 criminal /ˈkrɪmənəl/ 刑事

136

My cardinal sin was allowing myself to be reeled in by your tales of what a model citizen you are.” Kate could feel herself getting dizzy and light-headed, surprised by the audacity she had, talking to anyone in that manner.

我最大的罪过就是让自己被你们关于模范公民的故事所困扰。”凯特能感觉到自己变得头晕目眩，她对自己以这种方式与任何人说话的大胆感到惊讶。

cardinal /ˈkɑrdɪnəl/ 红衣主教 allowing /əˈlaʊɪŋ/ 允许 citizen /ˈsɪtɪzən/ 公民 light-headed /ˈhɛdɪd/ 头晕的 surprised /səˈpraɪzd/ 惊讶

137

Before she lost complete control, she would have to get out of there.

在她完全失去控制之前，她必须离开那里。

complete /kəmˈplit/ 完全的 control /kənˈtroʊl/ 控制

138

She stood, turned, and marched toward the door.

她站起来，转身，大步朝门口走去。

marched /mɑrʧt/ 游行

139

As she began to open the front door, she looked back.

当她开始打开前门时，她回头看了一眼。

140

Victor stood beside his chair, pale and shaken. “You admitted you were a fraud in your youth.

维克多站在椅子旁边，脸色苍白，浑身颤抖。 “你承认自己年轻时是个骗子。

admitted /ədˈmɪtəd/ 承认

141

You are still a fraud!

你还是个骗子！

142

I will write your story... my version!

我会写你的故事......我的版本！

version /ˈvərʒən/ 版本

143

My guess is that the eventual verdict will be‘guilty’!”

我猜测，最终的判决会是‘有罪’！”

eventual /əˈvɛnʧuəl/ 最终的 verdict /ˈvərdɪkt/ 判决

docs.title: The Pasture
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

Night settled, thick with the acrid odors of gunpowder and blood.

夜幕降临，充满了火药和血的刺鼻气味。

settled /ˈsɛtəld/ 定居 gunpowder /ˈgənˌpaʊdər/ 火药

002

No moon meant firing at muzzle flashes, an inexact method by which to combat one's foe, but the enemy had no advantage either.

没有月亮意味着用枪口闪光开火，这是一种不精确的打击敌人的方法，但敌人也没有优势。

moon /mun/ 月亮 flashes /ˈflæʃɪz/ 闪烁 inexact /ˌɪnɪgˈzækt/ 不精确的 foe /foʊ/ 敌人 advantage /ædˈvæntɪʤ/ 优势

003

With artillery fire blanketing the field of battle, Jack had no opportunity to go to Mike's aid.

由于炮火覆盖了战场，杰克没有机会去援助迈克。

artillery /ɑrˈtɪləri/ 炮兵 blanketing /ˈblæŋkətɪŋ/ 覆盖 opportunity /ˌɑpərˈtunəti/ 机会

004

He poked his head over the rim of the trench to see if he could spot Mike's corpse.

他把头伸出战壕的边缘，看看是否能发现迈克的尸体。

005

He knew he was dead.

他知道他已经死了。

006

He had heard his scream of pain when he was hit.

当他被击中时，他听到了痛苦的尖叫声。

007

His agonized moans had grown weaker and less frequent and finally ceased about ten minutes ago.

他痛苦的呻吟声越来越弱，频率也越来越低，大约十分钟前终于停止了。

agonized /ˈægəˌnaɪzd/ 痛苦的 frequent /ˈfrikˌwɛnt/ 经常 finally /ˈfaɪnəli/ 最后 minutes /ˈmɪnəts/ 分钟

008

The regiment had been under heavy bombardment for two days, without respite.

该团已经连续两天遭受猛烈炮击，没有喘息的机会。

regiment /ˈrɛʤəmənt/ 团 bombardment /bɑmˈbɑrdmənt/ 轰击 respite /ˈrɛspɪt/ 喘息

009

He had been too late to stop Mike as he propelled himself out of the foxhole and staggered as he hit the muddy terrain.

当迈克从散兵坑里爬出来时，他来不及阻止，当他跌倒在泥泞的地面上时，他摇摇晃晃。

propelled /prəˈpɛld/ 推动的 foxhole /ˈfɑksˌhoʊl/ 散兵坑 staggered /ˈstægərd/ 交错 terrain /təreɪn/ 地形

010

In hindsight, he should have seen it coming.

事后看来，他应该预见到这一点。

hindsight /ˈhaɪnˌsaɪt/ 事后诸葛亮

011

Mike had started to break yesterday.

迈克昨天就开始崩溃了。

started /ˈstɑrtɪd/ 开始了

012

He was becoming bizarre, talking about his patriotic duty to expel the enemy from these shores.

他变得很奇怪，谈论他将敌人驱逐出这些海岸的爱国义务。

becoming /bɪˈkəmɪŋ/ 成为 bizarre /bɪˈzɑr/ 奇异的 talking /ˈtɔkɪŋ/ 说 patriotic /ˌpeɪtriˈɑtɪk/ 爱国

013

Paradoxically, just before he hopped over the edge of the trench he scorned the day he had heeded the call to enlist.

矛盾的是，就在他跳出战壕边缘之前，他对自己响应入伍号召的那一天嗤之以鼻。

paradoxically /ˌpɛrəˈdɑksəkəli/ 自相矛盾地 scorned /skɔrnd/ 被蔑视

014

It pained him to realize that his one friend in this ungodly war had betrayed him by dying.

当他意识到他在这场不敬虔的战争中的一位朋友因死亡而背叛了他时，他感到痛苦。

realize /ˈriəˌlaɪz/ 意识到 ungodly /ənˈgɔdli/ 不敬虔的 war /wɔr/ 战争 betrayed /bɪˈtreɪd/ 被背叛

015

Soldiers don't often make friends with one another, knowing they might die.

士兵们知道自己可能会死去，因此不会经常互相交朋友。

soldiers /ˈsoʊlʤərz/ 士兵 friends /frɛndz/ 朋友们 knowing /noʊɪŋ/ 会心

016

He and Mike were different.

他和迈克不同。

different /ˈdɪfərənt/ 不同的

017

They had known each other since they were children.

他们从小就认识。

children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们

018

Mike was the best man when Jack and Lily walked down the aisle just a week before they left the dock and crossed the channel to engage the enemy.

就在杰克和莉莉离开码头、越过英吉利海峡与敌人交战前一周，当杰克和莉莉走上过道时，迈克是伴郎。

aisle /aɪəl/ 走道 crossed /krɔst/ 交叉的 channel /ˈʧænəl/ 渠道

019

Clouds tumbled and overlapped one another as the wind began to freshen.

随着风开始变得清新，云层翻滚并相互重叠。

tumbled /ˈtəmbəld/ 跌倒了 overlapped /ˈoʊvərˌlæpt/ 重叠的 freshen /ˈfrɛʃən/ 清新

020

It was getting colder now.

现在天气越来越冷了。

021

The prospect of another night of rain, or perhaps even snow, made Jack quiver with dread.

一想到又会下一场雨，甚至可能下雪，杰克就害怕得浑身发抖。

prospect /ˈprɑspɛkt/ 前景 perhaps /pərˈhæps/ 也许

022

Blood tinged water was beginning to crust over with ice.

带有血色的水开始结冰。

beginning /bɪˈgɪnɪŋ/ 开始

023

He could feel his toes and fingers stiffen as the temperature dropped.

随着温度的下降，他能感觉到自己的脚趾和手指都变得僵硬了。

fingers /ˈfɪŋgərz/ 手指 stiffen /ˈstɪfən/ 变硬 temperature /ˈtɛmpərəʧər/ 温度 dropped /drɑpt/ 掉落

024

Maybe Mike was better off than he.

也许迈克比他过得更好。

025

At least the cold wouldn't bother him any more.

至少寒冷不会再困扰他了。

wouldn't /ˈwʊdənt/ 不会

026

Suddenly, comets of light began to streak across the night sky.

突然，夜空开始划过彗星。

suddenly /ˈsədənli/ 突然

027

They were using flares!

You were very dehydrated and suffering from urinary retention and renal failure.

您严重脱水，并患有尿潴留和肾功能衰竭。

dehydrated /dɪˈhaɪdreɪtəd/ 脱水的 suffering /ˈsəfərɪŋ/ 痛苦 urinary /ˈjərəˌnɛri/ 尿 retention /riˈtɛnʃən/ 保留 failure /ˈfeɪljər/ 失败

116

Your kidneys may never function normally again.

您的肾脏可能再也无法正常运作。

kidneys /ˈkɪdniz/ 肾脏 function /ˈfəŋkʃən/ 功能 normally /ˈnɔrməli/ 通常情况下

117

The good news is that you survived,” she explained.

好消息是你活了下来，”她解释道。

survived /sərˈvaɪvd/ 幸存下来 explained /ɪkˈspleɪnd/ 解释了

118

A stray strand of hair fell across Jack's cheek hiding the tears that crept from his eyes.

一缕头发落在杰克的脸颊上，遮住了他眼中涌出的泪水。

119

He was grateful to have his life back.

他很感激自己能重获新生。

grateful /ˈgreɪtfəl/ 感激的

120

He silently saluted his friend.

他默默地向他的朋友行礼。

silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ 默默 saluted /səˈlutəd/ 敬礼

121

Mike hadn't been so lucky.

迈克就没那么幸运了。

122

The cable from Lily arrived the next day. “We have a son stop Born 05 Dec. stop Healthy stop Named him Michael stop I love you.

莉莉的电报第二天就到了。 “我们有一个儿子 stop 出生于 12 月 5 日 stop 健康 stop 给他起名叫迈克尔 stop 我爱你。

arrived /əraɪvd/ 到达的 healthy /ˈhɛlθi/ 健康 michael /ˈmaɪkəl/ 迈克尔

123

Lily stop P.

莉莉停止P。

124

S.

S。

125

Dad bought the pasture and deeded it to Michael.”

爸爸买下了牧场并将其转让给了迈克尔。”

pasture /ˈpæsʧər/ 牧场 michael /ˈmaɪkəl/ 迈克尔

docs.title: The Decision
docs.text:
原文链接：Part 1 / Part 2

复习方式：先读英文，再看译文，最后只背本句下面的词和短语。

001

Dr. Sam said to me: “I don't know how to say this, except to come right out with it, Miriam.

山姆博士对我说：“我不知道该怎么说，除非直接说出来，米里亚姆。

002

The tests we did last week show that there are abnormalities with the fetus.

我们上周做的检查显示胎儿存在异常。

abnormalities /ˌæbnɔrˈmælətiz/ 异常

003

I recommend you consider an abortion.” I sat, hands folded together in my lap, numbed by his words.

我建议你考虑堕胎。”我坐下来，双手交叉放在腿上，被他的话弄得麻木了。

recommend /ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd/ 推荐 consider /kənˈsɪdər/ 考虑 abortion /əˈbɔrʃən/ 流产 together /təˈgɛðər/ 一起

004

The world around me disappeared as I strove to absorb the dreadful news Dr. Sam was giving me.

当我努力吸收山姆医生告诉我的可怕消息时，我周围的世界消失了。

disappeared /ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd/ 消失了 dreadful /ˈdrɛdfəl/ 可怕

005

His voice came to me as if spoken in a tunnel, hollow and echoing.

他的声音传到我耳中，就像在隧道里说话一样，空洞而有回声。

echoing /ˈɛkoʊɪŋ/ 回声

006

Could this be true, The baby inside me, the miracle created by love, wasn't perfect! “Your baby has a condition known as Down's Syndrome.

难道这是真的吗？我体内的婴儿，爱创造的奇迹，并不完美！ “你的宝宝患有唐氏综合症。

miracle /ˈmɪrəkəl/ 奇迹 created /kriˈeɪtɪd/ 已创建 perfect /ˈpərˌfɪkt/ 完美的 condition /kənˈdɪʃən/ 状况 syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症

007

The problems you will face if you don't terminate this pregnancy could be overwhelming, especially now that Paul is no longer with you.” Here I was, thirty nine years old, pregnant for the first time, and my doctor, my trusted friend, was telling me I should kill this innocent life in my womb.

如果你不终止妊娠，你将面临的问题可能会是巨大的，尤其是现在保罗已经不再和你在一起了。”我三十九岁了，第一次怀孕，我的医生、我值得信赖的朋友告诉我，我应该杀死子宫里这个无辜的生命。

problems /ˈprɑbləmz/ 问题 terminate /ˈtərməˌneɪt/ 终止 pregnancy /ˈprɛgnənsi/ 怀孕 overwhelming /ˌoʊvərˈwɛlmɪŋ/ 压倒 especially /əˈspɛʃəli/ 尤其

008

I knew I had to respond but words escaped me.

我知道我必须做出回应，但我却无法言语。

respond /rɪˈspɑnd/ 回应 escaped /ɪˈskeɪpt/ 逃脱了

009

Finally, I was able to speak. “I need some time to consider my options.

终于，我能够说话了。 “我需要一些时间来考虑我的选择。

finally /ˈfaɪnəli/ 最后 consider /kənˈsɪdər/ 考虑 options /ˈɔpʃənz/ 选项

010

With all that has happened in the past month and a half, I don't want to do anything without knowing all I can about this.” “You don't have long, Miriam.

鉴于过去一个半月里发生的一切，我不想在不了解情况的情况下做任何事情。” “你的时间不多了，米丽亚姆。

happened /ˈhæpənd/ 发生了 anything /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/ 任何事物 knowing /noʊɪŋ/ 会心

011

You are eleven weeks along and it's dangerous to perform an abortion after twelve weeks, try not to prolong your decision.” “It's too much for me to get my head around right now.

你已经怀孕十一周了，十二周后堕胎是很危险的，尽量不要拖延你的决定。” “现在对我来说太多了，无法集中精力。

dangerous /ˈdeɪnʤərəs/ 危险的 perform /pərˈfɔrm/ 履行 abortion /əˈbɔrʃən/ 流产 prolong /prəˈlɔŋ/ 延长 decision /dɪˈsɪʒən/ 决定

012

I need to think.

我需要思考。

013

I promise Ill get back to you in a day or so.” I left the office in a daze.

我保证我会在一天左右回复您。”我茫然地离开了办公室。

promise /ˈprɑməs/ 承诺

014

What was I going to do, Where would I begin, Who, besides Dr. Sam, would be able to advise me, My parents were on the other side of the world, teaching in China.

我要做什么，我要从哪里开始，除了山姆博士之外，谁能给我建议，我的父母在世界的另一端，在中国教书。

besides /ˌbiˈsaɪdz/ 除了 parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 teaching /ˈtiʧɪŋ/ 教学

015

I felt that if I could talk to Mom, held in her comforting arms, she would give me some of her wisdom.

我觉得如果我能和妈妈说话，在她安慰的怀抱里，她会给我一些她的智慧。

comforting /ˈkəmfərtɪŋ/ 安慰的

016

If I could be face-to-face with Dad, he would give me strength.

如果我能和爸爸面对面，他会给我力量。

face-to-face /ˈfeɪstuˈfeɪs/ 面对面 strength /strɛŋθ/ 力量

017

They were all I had left in my world.

他们是我的世界里仅存的一切。

018

My husband, Paul, had been killed in a traffic accident six weeks ago.

我的丈夫保罗在六周前的一场交通事故中丧生。

husband /ˈhəzbənd/ 丈夫 traffic /ˈtræfɪk/ 交通 accident /ˈæksədənt/ 事故

019

Mom and Dad had gone back to China a week after the funeral, when they thought I was able to cope with my loss.

葬礼一周后，爸爸妈妈就回到了中国，他们认为我能够应对失去亲人的痛苦。

funeral /fˈjunərəl/ 葬礼 thought /θɔt/ 想法

020

There was nowhere to turn.

无处可去。

nowhere /ˈnoʊˌwɛr/ 无处

021

I had to face reality.

我不得不面对现实。

reality /ˌriˈæləˌti/ 现实

022

This was a decision I would make on my own.

这是我自己做出的决定。

decision /dɪˈsɪʒən/ 决定

023

I needed to gather all the information I could about Down's syndrome.

我需要收集有关唐氏综合症的所有信息。

information /ˌɪnˌfɔrˈmeɪʃən/ 信息 syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症

024

I wasted no time.

我没有浪费时间。

025

I went to the library to begin my research.

我去了图书馆开始我的研究。

library /ˈlaɪbrɛˌri/ 图书馆 research /ˈrisərʧ/ 研究

026

The steps to the future were in my hands.

通往未来的脚步掌握在我的手中。

027

The first medical journal I chose explained the causes of Down's syndrome.

我选择的第一份医学杂志解释了唐氏综合症的原因。

medical /ˈmɛdɪkəl/ 医疗的 journal /ˈʤərnəl/ 杂志 explained /ɪkˈspleɪnd/ 解释了 syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症

028

Normally, each egg and sperm cell contains 23 chromosomes, and, when they unite, 23 pairs or 46 in total.

正常情况下，每个卵子和精子细胞含有 23 条染色体，当它们结合时，总共有 23 对或 46 条染色体。

normally /ˈnɔrməli/ 通常情况下 contains /kənˈteɪnz/ 包含 chromosomes /ˈkroʊməˌzoʊmz/ 染色体

029

Occasionally, an accident occurs when the egg or sperm cell is forming, creating an extra chromosome number 21.

有时，卵子或精子细胞形成时会发生意外，产生额外的 21 号染色体。

occasionally /ɔˈkeɪʒənəˌli/ 偶尔 accident /ˈæksədənt/ 事故 forming /ˈfɔrmɪŋ/ 成型 creating /kriˈeɪtɪŋ/ 创造 chromosome /ˈkroʊməˌzoʊm/ 染色体

030

This extra chromosome results in the features of Down's syndrome.

这条额外的染色体导致了唐氏综合症的特征。

chromosome /ˈkroʊməˌzoʊm/ 染色体 results /rɪˈzəlts/ 结果 features /ˈfiʧərz/ 特征 syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症

031

In the past, this disorder was called “Mongolism” because of the facial characteristics including slanted eyes and a small, flattened nasal bridge.

过去，这种疾病因面部特征包括倾斜的眼睛和小而扁平的鼻梁而被称为“蒙古病”。

disorder /dɪˈsɔrdər/ 紊乱 mongolism：蒙古主义 because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为 characteristics /ˌkɛrɪktərˈɪstɪks/ 特征 including /ˌɪnˈkludɪŋ/ 包括

032

It is a common genetic birth defect affecting about one in 800 to 1000 births when the mother is 30 years of age.

这是一种常见的遗传性出生缺陷，当母亲 30 岁时，大约有 800 至 1000 名新生儿中就有一人患有这种缺陷。

genetic /ʤəˈnɛtɪk/ 遗传的 affecting /əˈfɛktɪŋ/ 影响

033

The odds of my having a Down syndrome increased to one in 100 because I was in my fortieth year.

因为我已经四十岁了，所以我患唐氏综合症的几率增加到百分之一。

syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症 increased /ˌɪnˈkrist/ 增加 because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为 fortieth /ˈfɔrtiɪθ/ 第四十

034

There is no cure for this disorder.

这种疾病无法治愈。

disorder /dɪˈsɔrdər/ 紊乱

035

Neither is there any prevention.

也没有任何预防措施。

neither /ˈniðər/ 两者都不 prevention /priˈvɛnʃən/ 预防

036

My child would be developmentally and physically retarded to a greater or lesser degree.

我的孩子或多或少会出现发育和身体发育迟缓。

developmentally /dɪˌvɛləpˈmɛnəli/ 发展地 physically /ˈfɪzɪkəli/ 身体上的 retarded /rɪˈtɑrdɪd/ 迟钝的 greater /ˈgreɪtər/ 更大

037

She could have numerous health problems.

她可能有许多健康问题。

numerous /ˈnumərəs/ 很多的 problems /ˈprɑbləmz/ 问题

038

It was unlikely she would ever marry and her having children was out of the question.

她不太可能结婚，也不可能生孩子。

unlikely /ənˈlaɪkli/ 不太可能 children /ˈʧɪldrən/ 孩子们 question /kˈwɛʃən/ 问题

039

Her life expectancy could be as little as 55 years.

她的预期寿命可能只有 55 岁。

expectancy /ɪkˈspɛktənsi/ 预期

040

Paul and I had been married for ten years and had always regretted the fact that I had been unable to conceive.

保罗和我结婚十年了，一直为我无法怀孕而感到遗憾。

married /ˈmɛrid/ 已婚 regretted /rɪˈgrɛtɪd/ 后悔了 conceive /kənˈsiv/ 构想

041

After he died, I attributed my nausea, vomiting and lethargy to my grief, never suspecting that I might be pregnant.

他去世后，我将恶心、呕吐和嗜睡归因于悲伤，从未怀疑过自己可能怀孕了。

attributed /əˈtrɪbjətəd/ 归因于 vomiting /ˈvɑmətɪŋ/ 呕吐 lethargy /ˈlɛθərʤi/ 昏睡 suspecting /səˈspɛktɪŋ/ 怀疑 pregnant /ˈprɛgnənt/ 孕

042

Poor Paul would never know that we would have a child together.

可怜的保罗永远不会知道我们会有一个孩子。

together /təˈgɛðər/ 一起

043

This thought alone was what made me realize that I wouldn't be able to have an abortion, no matter what obstacles might be ahead of us.

仅这个想法就让我意识到，无论我们面前有什么障碍，我都无法堕胎。

thought /θɔt/ 想法 realize /ˈriəˌlaɪz/ 意识到 wouldn't /ˈwʊdənt/ 不会 abortion /əˈbɔrʃən/ 流产 obstacles /ˈɑbstəkəlz/ 障碍

044

Iwaited a day before calling Dr. Sam to inform him of my decision.

我等了一天才打电话给山姆医生告诉他我的决定。

iwaited：我等待着 calling /ˈkɔlɪŋ/ 呼叫 decision /dɪˈsɪʒən/ 决定

045

I had to be sure! “Miriam, I think I know why you want to go through with this pregnancy, but are you aware of the risks,” “I know my baby will be different.

我必须确定！ “米里亚姆，我想我知道你为什么想经历这次怀孕，但你知道其中的风险吗？”“我知道我的孩子会有所不同。

pregnancy /ˈprɛgnənsi/ 怀孕 different /ˈdɪfərənt/ 不同的

046

I know she may be mentally and physically retarded.

我知道她可能在智力和身体上都有缺陷。

mentally /ˈmɛnəli/ 精神上 physically /ˈfɪzɪkəli/ 身体上的 retarded /rɪˈtɑrdɪd/ 迟钝的

047

She may have developmental difficulties and problems with social acceptance.

她可能有发育困难和社会接受度问题。

developmental /dɪˌvɛləpˈmɛnəl/ 发展性的 difficulties /ˈdɪfɪˌkəltiz/ 困难 problems /ˈprɑbləmz/ 问题 acceptance /əkˈsɛptəns/ 验收

048

I do recognize that I am going to have to amend almost every facet of my life.

我确实认识到我将不得不改变我生活的几乎每个方面。

recognize /ˈrɛkəgˌnaɪz/ 认出

049

I am prepared to do that.

我准备这样做。

prepared /priˈpɛrd/ 准备好了

050

This is my final gift from Paul and I am determined to go through with this!” “I thought you would feel that way.

这是保罗给我的最后一份礼物，我决心完成这一切！” “我以为你会有这种感觉。

determined /dɪˈtərmənd/ 决定 thought /θɔt/ 想法

051

You have my utmost admiration and support.

我对您表示最大的钦佩和支持。

admiration /ˌædmərˈeɪʃən/ 钦佩 support /səˈpɔrt/ 支持

052

I will follow your pregnancy carefully but I want you to see a specialist in birth defects.

我会仔细跟踪您的怀孕情况，但我希望您去看出生缺陷专家。

pregnancy /ˈprɛgnənsi/ 怀孕 carefully /ˈkɛrfəli/ 小心 specialist /ˈspɛʃəlɪst/ 专家 defects /ˈdifɛkts/ 缺陷

053

I will refer you to Dr. Brown and would like you to make an appointment with her as soon as possible,” he said.

我会将您转介给布朗医生，并希望您尽快与她预约，”他说。

appointment /əˈpɔɪntmənt/ 预约 possible /ˈpɑsəbəl/ 可能的

054

I knew then that I had made the right choice.

我当时就知道我做出了正确的选择。

055

My pregnancy was not without its hardships, from morning sickness to swollen ankles, but I had no doubts about the decision I had made.

我的怀孕过程并非一帆风顺，从孕吐到脚踝肿胀，但我对自己做出的决定毫不怀疑。

pregnancy /ˈprɛgnənsi/ 怀孕 hardships /ˈhɑrdʃɪps/ 艰辛 morning /ˈmɔrnɪŋ/ 早晨 sickness /ˈsɪknəs/ 疾病 swollen /sˈwoʊlən/ 肿

056

My parents, when I told them what was going on with me, expressed their concerns but also their confidence in my decision and assured me they would be there when I delivered my baby.

当我告诉我的父母我发生了什么事时，他们表达了他们的担忧，但也对我的决定充满信心，并向我保证，当我生下孩子时，他们会在场。

parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 expressed /ɪkˈsprɛst/ 表达的 concerns /kənˈsərnz/ 担忧 confidence /ˈkɑnfədɛns/ 信心 decision /dɪˈsɪʒən/ 决定

057

Paula was born on a bright, cloudless, warm Tuesday morning in May.

宝拉出生于五月一个晴朗、万里无云、温暖的星期二早晨。

cloudless /ˈklaʊdləs/ 无云的 tuesday /ˈtuzˌdeɪ/ 周二 morning /ˈmɔrnɪŋ/ 早晨

058

I was prepared to see a red, wrinkled, squalling infant.

我已经准备好看到一个通红、满脸皱纹、嚎叫的婴儿了。

prepared /priˈpɛrd/ 准备好了 wrinkled /ˈrɪŋkəld/ 皱 squalling /skwɔl/ 叫嚷

059

Instead, I saw very little.

相反，我看到的很少。

instead /ˌɪnˈstɛd/ 反而

060

Because of the risks involved, Paula was delivered by Caesarian section.

由于存在风险，宝拉是通过剖腹产出生的。

because /bɪˈkəz/ 因为 involved /ˌɪnˈvɑlvd/ 涉及 delivered /dɪˈlɪvərd/ 发表 caesarian：剖腹产 section /ˈsɛkʃən/ 部分

061

The doctors and nurses rushed her into an incubatorto assess her before I caught a glimpse of her.

在我瞥见她之前，医生和护士把她推进保温箱进行评估。

doctors /ˈdɑktərz/ 医生 incubatorto：孵化器 glimpse /glɪmps/ 一瞥

062

I could see my parents on the other side of the operating room window, questions in their eyes.

我可以看到我的父母在手术室窗户的另一边，他们眼中充满疑问。

parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 operating /ˈɔpərˌeɪtɪŋ/ 操作 questions /kˈwɛsʧənz/ 问题

063

What was going on, The nurses kept me comfortable and tried to alleviate my fears but half an hour passed before our questions were answered.

发生了什么事，护士让我感到舒适，并试图减轻我的恐惧，但半小时后我们的问题才得到答复。

comfortable /ˈkəmfərtəbəl/ 舒服的 alleviate /əˈliviˌeɪt/ 减轻 questions /kˈwɛsʧənz/ 问题 answered /ˈænsərd/ 回答了

064

My daughter had a severe heart defect.

我女儿患有严重的心脏缺陷。

daughter /ˈdɔtər/ 女儿

065

It could be corrected through surgery but not until she gained a little weight and strength.

可以通过手术来纠正，但要等到她的体重和力量增加一点为止。

corrected /kərˈɛktɪd/ 已纠正 surgery /ˈsərʤəri/ 外科手术 strength /strɛŋθ/ 力量

066

I understood in that moment that my life had changed forever.

那一刻我明白我的生活永远改变了。

understood /ˌəndərˈstʊd/ 明白了 changed /ʧeɪnʤd/ 改变了 forever /fərˈɛvər/ 永远

067

I demanded to see her immediately, and as soon as I did, I fell in love.

我要求立即见到她，我一见到她，我就爱上了她。

demanded /dɪˈmændɪd/ 要求的 immediately /ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli/ 立即地

068

This most precious of all gifts was going to survive the obstacles ahead of her with my help.

在我的帮助下，这份最珍贵的礼物将克服她面前的障碍。

precious /ˈprɛʃəs/ 宝贵的 survive /sərˈvaɪv/ 存活 obstacles /ˈɑbstəkəlz/ 障碍

069

I knew in an instant that all my strength,love, and monetary resources were at her command.

我立刻知道我所有的力量、爱情和金钱都在她的掌控之中。

instant /ˈɪnstənt/ 立即的 strength /strɛŋθ/ 力量 monetary /ˈmɑnəˌtɛri/ 货币 resources /ˈrisɔrsɪz/ 资源 command /kəˈmænd/ 命令

070

Nothing she wanted, needed, or even dreamed of, would ever be denied.

她想要的、需要的、甚至梦想的一切都不会被拒绝。

nothing /ˈnəθɪŋ/ 没有什么 dreamed /drimd/ 梦见

071

The heart surgery to correct a flawed valve was a resounding success.

纠正有缺陷的瓣膜的心脏手术取得了巨大成功。

surgery /ˈsərʤəri/ 外科手术 correct /kərˈɛkt/ 正确的 resounding /riˈsaʊndɪŋ/ 高亢 success /səkˈsɛs/ 成功

072

Fortunately, the common defects occurring in a majority of Down's syndrome children were absent in Paula.

幸运的是，大多数唐氏综合症儿童常见的缺陷在宝拉身上并不存在。

fortunately /ˈfɔrʧənətli/ 幸运的是 defects /ˈdifɛkts/ 缺陷 occurring /əˈkərɪŋ/ 发生 majority /məˈʤɔrəti/ 多数 syndrome /ˈsɪnˌdroʊm/ 综合症

073

She has no intestinal malformations, hearing impairment, or severe visual problems.

她没有肠道畸形、听力障碍或严重的视力问题。

intestinal /ˌɪnˈtɛstɪnəl/ 肠 malformations /ˌmælfɔrˈmeɪʃənz/ 畸形 hearing /ˈhirɪŋ/ 听力 impairment /ˌɪmˈpɛrmənt/ 损伤 problems /ˈprɑbləmz/ 问题

074

We are truly blessed.

我们真的很幸运。

blessed /blɛst/ 有福的

075

My parents adore this exceptional grandchild.

我的父母非常喜欢这个出色的孙子。

parents /ˈpɛrənts/ 父母 exceptional /ɪkˈsɛpʃənəl/ 异常的 grandchild /ˈgrænˌʧaɪld/ 孙子

076

Their expertise in teaching, nurturing, and parenting has been so welcome.

他们在教学、培养和育儿方面的专业知识非常受欢迎。

expertise /ˌɛkspərˈtiz/ 专业知识 teaching /ˈtiʧɪŋ/ 教学 nurturing /ˈnərʧərɪŋ/ 养育 parenting /ˈpɛrəntɪŋ/ 养育子女 welcome /ˈwɛlkəm/ 欢迎

077

I always knew they were there for me; now they are there for us.

我一直都知道他们就在我身边；现在他们就在我们身边。

078

I am aware of the sympathetic looks from strangers who don't know or understand the disorder afflicting my child.

我注意到那些不知道或不了解我孩子所患疾病的陌生人投来同情的目光。
